# Email

Create email campaigns.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Before you begin
> 
> Complete the [email channel setup](doc:campaigns-getting-started-email) before creating a campaign.

To create an email campaign, go to **Campaigns > Message campaigns**, click **\+ Create campaign** , and select **Email**.

![](https://files.readme.io/50225dc71f908bfd6743c99edeb1d3a97474ca42100bce7c99ca71ebf00264f0-message-campaigns-create.png)

Next, complete the campaign settings.

  1. Audience: Set campaign info and choose your audience.
  2. Creative: Design campaign creatives and variants.
  3. Settings: Set campaign-level settings, such as the schedule and campaign goals.
  4. Review & launch: Confirm your settings before launching.



* * *

## 

1\. Set campaign info and choose your audience

Enter your campaign's basic information, choose a campaign type, and select your audience.

### 

Campaign info

Enter a campaign name and optionally, add tags which can be used for filtering in the [campaign list](doc:campaigns-regular-manage).

![](https://files.readme.io/28d353fd8a929c973b7cf9bd58b006d23abce79fa9a295ed2e2d9163c114204f-email-create-info.png)

### 

Campaign type

Choose how the campaign should be sent. If you're creating a **Trigger** campaign, select which platform's events to use as campaign triggers.

![](https://files.readme.io/4bc649eb7df1c24bc0be0caa19334112d92ac0327d52822f62f6085dab8aeb32-message-create-campaign-type.png)

Campaign type| Description  
---|---  
**Regular**|  Send campaigns manually or on a fixed schedule.  
**Trigger**|  Add a trigger rule to send campaigns users meet certain conditions, such as browsing a page or adding a product to their cart.  
  
### 

Trigger rule

If you selected **Trigger** for the campaign type, set a trigger rule. When users trigger the rule, they'll receive the campaign

![](https://files.readme.io/a53c2710b50c324b2760acde2679b88335871f0bdefab0eed0058d2c696f7085-message-create-trigger-rule.png)

Rule| Description| Example use cases  
---|---|---  
**User action**|  Send the campaign after the user completes a certain action.Note that any events that satisfy event conditions can trigger the campaign, even if the event occurred before the campaign started running.| • Send a checkout reminder to users one day after adding an item to their cart if the purchase wasn't completed.• Send a new member promotion to users 10 minutes after creating an account.  
**Relative date**|  Set the campaign send time based on a user's date-based attribute, such as their birthday or membership joining date.Please note the following requirements:  
  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• The event or attribute parameters to be used as the trigger condition need to follow the [date format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#date-format) or [datetime format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#datetime-format).| • Send a birthday coupon a week before the user's birthday.• Send a membership anniversary discount code.  
**Feed change**|  Send the campaign to certain users when the product data feed is updated.Data feed conditions are checked once a day at the **Send time** configured in the campaign settings. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at that time.Please note the following requirements:  
  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• Your [product feed](doc:product-data-feed) must be onboarded.| • Send a notification to users who browsed "Product A" if that product's price is lowered by 10% (check daily at 10:00 AM).• Send a restock notification to users who added an out-of-stock product to their cart when it's restocked (check daily at 12:00 PM).  
  
### 

Audience

Under the **Audience** section, select which segments to include and exclude from the campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/e144c285d18fb0630147a72545c4475b99022333908e9dd76f70a6b63561c219-regular-email-create-audience.png)

Audience setting| Description  
---|---  
**Users to include**|  Users in this segment will receive the campaign. If no segment is selected, the value will be **All users** , and every user will receive the campaign. You can select up to 10 segments.  
**Users to exclude**|  Users in this segment won't receive the campaign. You can select up to 10 segments.  
  
For example, to send the campaign to users who haven't validated their phone number:

  * **Users to include** : Keep the default value of **All users** without selecting any segment.
  * **Users to exclude** : Select a segment containing users who completed phone validation.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Regular campaigns: Estimated audience size
> 
> Regular campaigns provide an estimated audience size with a margin of error of approximately 5%, so this estimate may differ slightly from numbers visible in the segment list.

* * *

## 

2\. Set up creatives

Under **Template** , click **\+ Add email creative** , and select how you'd like to add the creative. For details about email creatives and the different ways to create one, see [Email creatives](doc:creatives-email).

![](https://files.readme.io/4a6d5979b5b37b0e89f82086c1c3815d0adb4a1ff63c3514d5f6e4e28b83a209-regular-email-template.gif)

> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> Experiments: Message campaigns
> 
> Set up campaign experiments to compare different creative variants and measure campaign effectiveness. For details, see [Experiments: Message campaigns](doc:campaigns-experiments-message).

* * *

## 

3\. Configure campaign settings

  * Under **Schedule**, choose how and when to send the campaign.
  * Under **Campaign settings**, configure campaign-level settings, such as the campaign's goals and frequency cap.



### 

Schedule

In the **Schedule** section, choose how you'd like to send the campaign.

  * Regular campaigns
  * Trigger campaigns: Feed change



#### 

Regular campaigns

Schedule type| Description  
---|---  
**Manual**|  Send the campaign by manually clicking the **Send now** button from the campaign list. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/965725c99e071cfbc890608554f0cc8239fe8f403d730489e3075052f9c1545e-regular-push-schedule-manual.png)  
**One-time**|  Send the campaign at a specific date and time. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/6d148d4f33a21f88846560fd7b3bedde983ded94456e0592dcee3b305d745ea1-regular-push-schedule-one-time.png)  
**Recurring**|  Specify the first campaign send time as well as the time interval (in days) for resending the campaign.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/b5b8e37be19d6121dea7da51da93d896f7c3454189ca064f7693fc777ed717f3-regular-push-schedule-recurring.png)  
  
#### 

Trigger campaigns: Feed change

**Send time** determines when the data feed is checked each day. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at this time. This setting is only available when the trigger rule is set to **Feed change**.

![](https://files.readme.io/89abea265eeabbcb566f154ce3881264ed8e4f1f898ffd5ff48ed5e97b0980fa-message-trigger-send-time.png)

### 

Campaign settings

The **Campaign settings** section contains settings for goal events, time to live, and frequency cap.

Campaign setting| Description  
---|---  
**Set campaign goals**|  Enabling this setting allows you to select events that will override the [account-level conversion events](doc:user-settings#conversion-and-attribution) for this campaign.   
In the campaign performance page of this campaign, conversion-related metrics will be calculated based on goal events instead of the account-level conversion events.  
**Bypass frequency cap**|  Only available if the campaign type is set to **Regular**.• Disabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval for regular campaigns will be applied.   
• Enabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval will be ignored. Select this option to override all frequency caps for important messages.   
Learn more about the notification frequency cap in [Account settings](doc:user-settings#notification-frequency-cap).  
  
* * *

## 

4\. Review & launch

Finally, review and confirm your campaign settings. When you're ready to launch the campaign, click **Publish**.

![](https://files.readme.io/78fe1edfb12adc2a39db221be8a441fe3783560f1da559870535094834e28d40-email-review-and-launch.png)

If you created a trigger campaign (**Campaign Type** set to **Trigger**), you'll need to enable the campaign from the campaign list—only campaigns with an **Active** status will be sent when trigger conditions are met.

![](https://files.readme.io/58c703b42c00fdfd820af176eafe7f9da52c61c75028e0b78da37bf5bd9688e9-message-trigger-enable.png)

# Kakao (Chingu Talk)

Create a Kakao campaign.

  1. Go to **Campaigns > Message campaigns**.
  2. Click **\+ Create campaign** , then select the channel and campaign type:
     1. **Kakao > Regular message**
     2. **Kakao > Trigger message**. In the settings page, set **Campaign Type** to **Instant Messaging** , and select **Kakao**.

![](https://files.readme.io/aee1101b674f917d84566ddb771a00e0ddcdccd1ed62981e14a6c2e613675025-Group_3_26.png)

  2. Next, set a schedule or a trigger, depending on whether you're creating a regular campaign or trigger campaign.
     1. Regular campaign: Set a campaign schedule.
     2. Trigger campaign: Create a trigger rule.
  3. Select the audience you want to target.

![](https://files.readme.io/4460cd8aa726d4888bfce5b852ff65436e146195bc003e72ee3d617d7fce75f3-image_4_4.png)

  4. Set up your creative.
     1. Select **Label content as advertising** if this campaign contains promotional content. This is required by law in some countries.
     2. Select **Insert Image** if you want to include an image in the campaign.
        1. Under **Image URL** , paste the URL generated via WiseMOKA.
        2. Under **Image Type** , choose the option you have set on WiseMOKA.
        3. If you enter a URL for **Destination web URL** , the users will be redirected to this page if they click on the image. Only web URLs are supported.
        4. Under **Message** , type the message. The character limit changes based on the image type selected. You can [add an AIQUA short URL to track clicks](doc:creatives-kakao-chingutalk#track-clicks-with-an-aiqua-short-url) on the campaign.
  5. If you want to include action buttons, select **Include Action Buttons**. You can add up to five action buttons.
     1. Under **Action Button Text** , type the text to be shown on the button.
     2. Under **Web URL** , enter the destination page that the users will be redirected to when they click the button. Only web URLs are supported.

![](https://files.readme.io/aac6363be99b700bdf29b0b8c75a672cf29ae7085ed7abeab66a36e39cd1758c-Group_4_21.png)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> The creative preview on the right is just an example. The layout and appearance of the actual notification may be different based on the settings you have configured.

  6. Use the **Test Your Creative** button to send a test creative to users in the Test Segment. You will need to first [add your Kakao phone number to the test segment](doc:segments-test-segment#kakao-and-sms-campaigns).
  7. Click **Save**.

# Kakao Moment

Create a Kakao Moment campaign.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Before you begin
> 
> Complete the [Kakao channel setup](doc:campaigns-getting-started-kakao-moment) before creating a campaign.

To create a Kakao Moment campaign, go to **Campaigns > Message campaigns**, and then click **\+ Create campaign > Kakao Moment**.

![](https://files.readme.io/ec77510c10004b9e225cf2fbcf4f22a85acadd70a0b9c53cd51c57513249639b-message-campaigns-create.png)

Next, complete the campaign settings.

  1. Audience: Set campaign info and choose your audience.
  2. Creative: Design campaign creatives and variants.
  3. Settings: Set campaign-level settings, such as the schedule and campaign goals.
  4. Review & launch: Confirm your settings before launching.



* * *

## 

1\. Set campaign info and choose your audience

Enter your campaign's basic information, choose a campaign type, and select your audience.

### 

Campaign info

Enter a campaign name and, optionally, add tags which can be used for filtering in the [campaign list](doc:campaigns-regular-manage).

![](https://files.readme.io/36948be9e901bac189deb566eff4e9c02d05a48fb62807affae4e8d8bef58e3b-kakao-moment-campaign-info.png)

### 

Audience

Under the **Audience** section, select which segments to include and exclude from the campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/ffdaed94912f299888cbc8f6fec01b2f510bbfc791809785113ace20aa28e1ee-line-campaign-audience.png)

Audience setting| Description  
---|---  
**Users to include**|  Users in this segment will receive the campaign. If no segment is selected, the value will be **All users** , and every user will receive the campaign. You can select one segment.  
**Users to exclude**|  Users in this segment won't receive the campaign. You can select one segment.  
  
For example, to send a campaign to users who didn't open your mobile app in the last 30 days:

  * **Users to include** : Don't select any segment to keep the default value of **All users**.
  * **Users to exclude** : Select a segment that contains users who have opened the app in the last 30 days.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Regular campaigns: Estimated audience size
> 
> Regular campaigns provide an estimated audience size with a margin of error of approximately 5%, so this estimate may differ slightly from numbers visible in the segment list.

* * *

## 

2\. Set up creatives

In the **Creative** section, select a message template and complete all the required fields. For each template's details and specifications, see [Kakao Moment Creatives](doc:creatives-kakao-moment).

> 👍
> 
> Ensure that your creative conforms to the specifications to ensure successful campaign delivery.

![](https://files.readme.io/f891cc598d782dfbd55d8e370524381aaa02e0127f3bc24fb8356c165c1a66f0-kakao-moment-campaign-creative.png)

After setting up the creative, click **Next** to finalize your campaign's settings.

* * *

## 

3\. Configure campaign settings

  * Under **Schedule**, choose how and when to send the campaign.
  * Under **Campaign settings**, configure campaign-level settings, such as the campaign's goals and frequency cap.



### 

Schedule

In the **Schedule** section, choose how you'd like to send the campaign.

Schedule type| Description  
---|---  
**Manual**|  Send the campaign by manually clicking the **Send now** button from the campaign list. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/965725c99e071cfbc890608554f0cc8239fe8f403d730489e3075052f9c1545e-regular-push-schedule-manual.png)  
**One-time**|  Send the campaign at a specific date and time. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/6d148d4f33a21f88846560fd7b3bedde983ded94456e0592dcee3b305d745ea1-regular-push-schedule-one-time.png)  
**Recurring**|  Specify the first campaign send time as well as the time interval (in days) for resending the campaign.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/b5b8e37be19d6121dea7da51da93d896f7c3454189ca064f7693fc777ed717f3-regular-push-schedule-recurring.png)  
  
### 

Campaign settings

Set your campaign's frequency cap settings. Note that [frequency cap settings](doc:user-settings#notification-frequency-cap) for Kakao (Chingu Talk) and Kakao Moment are independent.

Campaign setting| Description  
---|---  
**Bypass frequency cap**|  • Disabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval for regular campaigns will be applied.   
• Enabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval will be ignored. Select this option to override all frequency caps for important messages.   
  
  
* * *

## 

4\. Review & launch

Finally, review and confirm your campaign settings. When you're ready to launch the campaign, click **Publish**.

![](https://files.readme.io/ad259cb0ce858af418e061c942681da912efb86384a47b09ba73143e03213f91-kakao-moment-campaign-publish.png)

# LINE

Create a LINE campaign.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Before you begin
> 
> Complete the [LINE channel setup](doc:campaigns-getting-started-line) before creating a campaign.

To create a LINE campaign, go to **Campaigns > Message campaigns**, and then click **\+ Create campaign > LINE**.

![](https://files.readme.io/ec77510c10004b9e225cf2fbcf4f22a85acadd70a0b9c53cd51c57513249639b-message-campaigns-create.png)

Next, complete the campaign settings.

  1. Audience: Set campaign info and choose your audience.
  2. Creative: Design campaign creatives and variants.
  3. Settings: Set campaign-level settings, such as the schedule and campaign goals.
  4. Review & launch: Confirm your settings before launching.



* * *

## 

1\. Set campaign info and choose your audience

Enter your campaign's basic information, choose a campaign type, and select your audience.

### 

Campaign info

Enter a campaign name and, optionally, add tags which can be used for filtering in the [campaign list](doc:campaigns-regular-manage).

![](https://files.readme.io/5601b7e65a002e254c789501f99fd5218dc287123ea7aa263cc5e48bd93c173a-message-campaign-name-campaign-info.png)

### 

Campaign type

Choose how the campaign should be sent. If you're creating a **Trigger** campaign, select which platform's events to use as campaign triggers.

![](https://files.readme.io/4bc649eb7df1c24bc0be0caa19334112d92ac0327d52822f62f6085dab8aeb32-message-create-campaign-type.png)   


Campaign type| Description  
---|---  
**Regular**|  Send campaigns manually or on a fixed schedule.  
**Trigger**|  Add a trigger rule to send campaigns to users who meet certain conditions, such as browsing a page or adding a product to their cart.  
  
Trigger campaigns only work for LINE users who are synced with an existing web or app user. For a user to sync their web/app profile with their LINE profile, they must either:   
  
• Click on a link in AIQUA LINE campaigns (rich messages or carousel templates) and land on your SDK-integrated website or app.  
• Click on a LIFF URL. For details on how to create a LIFF URL, see [LINE User Sync](doc:campaigns-getting-started-line-user-sync).  
  
### 

Trigger rule

If you selected **Trigger** for the campaign type, set a trigger rule. When users trigger the rule, they'll receive the campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/a53c2710b50c324b2760acde2679b88335871f0bdefab0eed0058d2c696f7085-message-create-trigger-rule.png)

Rule| Description| Example use cases  
---|---|---  
**User action**|  Send the campaign after the user completes a certain action.Note that any events that satisfy event conditions can trigger the campaign, even if the event occurred before the campaign started running.| • Send a checkout reminder to users one day after adding an item to their cart if the purchase wasn't completed.• Send a new member promotion to users 10 minutes after creating an account.  
**Relative date**|  Set the campaign send time based on a user's date-based attribute, such as their birthday or membership joining date.Please note the following requirements:  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• The event or attribute parameters to be used as the trigger condition need to follow the [date format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#date-format) or [datetime format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#datetime-format).| • Send a birthday coupon a week before the user's birthday.• Send a membership anniversary discount code.  
**Feed change**|  Send the campaign to certain users when the product data feed is updated.Data feed conditions are checked once a day at the **Send time** configured in the campaign settings. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at that time.Please note the following requirements:  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• Your [product feed](doc:product-data-feed) must be onboarded.| • Send a notification to users who browsed "Product A" if that product's price is lowered by 10% (check daily at 10:00 AM).• Send a restock notification to users who added an out-of-stock product to their cart when the product is restocked (check daily at 12:00 PM).  
  
### 

Audience

Under the **Audience** section, select which segments to include and exclude from the campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/ffdaed94912f299888cbc8f6fec01b2f510bbfc791809785113ace20aa28e1ee-line-campaign-audience.png)

Audience setting| Description  
---|---  
**Users to include**|  Users in this segment will receive the campaign. If no segment is selected, the value will **All users** , and every user will receive the campaign. You can select one segment.  
**Users to exclude**|  Users in this segment won't receive the campaign. You can select one segment.  
  
For example, to send a campaign to users who didn't open your mobile app in the last 30 days:

  * **Users to include** : Don't select any segment to keep the default value of **All users**.
  * **Users to exclude** : Select a segment that contains users who have opened the app in the last 30 days.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Regular campaigns: Estimated audience size
> 
> Regular campaigns provide an estimated audience size with a margin of error of approximately 5%, so this estimate may differ slightly from numbers visible in the segment list.

* * *

## 

2\. Set up creatives

In the **Creative** section, add up to five message templates and complete all the required fields. For details about each template, see [LINE Creatives](doc:creatives-line).

![](https://files.readme.io/8979f8c128b515d6918d64075bad1f8f514dff8b82611c1e4a796602fe6f89e0-line-campaign-creative-settings.png)

After setting up the creative, click **Next** to finalize your campaign's settings.

* * *

## 

3\. Configure campaign settings

  * Under **Schedule**, choose how and when to send the campaign.
  * Under **Campaign settings**, configure campaign-level settings, such as campaign's goals and frequency cap.



### 

Schedule

In the **Schedule** section, choose how you'd like to send the campaign.

  * Regular campaigns
  * Trigger campaigns: Feed change



#### 

Regular campaigns

Schedule type| Description  
---|---  
**Manual**|  Send the campaign by manually clicking the **Send now** button from the campaign list. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/965725c99e071cfbc890608554f0cc8239fe8f403d730489e3075052f9c1545e-regular-push-schedule-manual.png)  
**One-time**|  Send the campaign at a specific date and time. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/6d148d4f33a21f88846560fd7b3bedde983ded94456e0592dcee3b305d745ea1-regular-push-schedule-one-time.png)  
**Recurring**|  Specify the first campaign send time as well as the time interval (in days) for resending the campaign.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/b5b8e37be19d6121dea7da51da93d896f7c3454189ca064f7693fc777ed717f3-regular-push-schedule-recurring.png)  
  
#### 

Trigger campaigns: Feed change

**Send time** determines when the data feed is checked each day. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at this time. This setting is only available when the trigger rule is set to **Feed change**.

![](https://files.readme.io/89abea265eeabbcb566f154ce3881264ed8e4f1f898ffd5ff48ed5e97b0980fa-message-trigger-send-time.png)

### 

Campaign settings

The **Campaign settings** section contains settings for goal events, time to live, and frequency cap.

Campaign setting| Description  
---|---  
**Set campaign goals**|  Enabling this setting allows you to select events that will override the [account-level conversion events](doc:user-settings#conversion-and-attribution) for this campaign.   
In the campaign performance page of this campaign, conversion-related metrics will be calculated based on goal events instead of the account-level conversion events.  
**Bypass frequency cap**|  Only available if the campaign type is set to **Regular**.Set the maximum number of LINE followers who should receive the campaign. If the sending cap is less than the total number of followers, followers will be randomly chosen to receive the campaign.  
  
* * *

## 

4\. Review & launch

Finally, review and confirm your campaign settings. When you're ready to launch the campaign, click **Publish**.

![](https://files.readme.io/f44bc8d3c7263a69c37eda664726f58f6f098e21855c500611438930bc631206-line-campaign-publish.png)

If you created a trigger campaign (**Campaign Type** set to **Trigger**), you'll need to enable the campaign from the campaign list—only campaigns with an **Active** status will be sent when trigger conditions are met.

# Push (Web and App)

Create Android, iOS, and web push campaigns.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Before you begin
> 
>   * For web push, complete the [web push channel setup](doc:campaigns-getting-started-web-push) before creating a campaign.
>   * For app push, ensure your app is integrated with the [Appier SDK](doc:sdk-getting-started) before creating a campaign.
> 


To create a push campaign, go to **Campaigns > Message campaigns**, then click **\+ Create campaign > Push**.

![](https://files.readme.io/ec77510c10004b9e225cf2fbcf4f22a85acadd70a0b9c53cd51c57513249639b-message-campaigns-create.png)

Next, complete the campaign settings.

  1. Audience: Set campaign info and choose your audience.
  2. Creative: Design campaign creatives and variants.
  3. Settings: Set campaign-level settings, such as the schedule and campaign goals.
  4. Review & launch: Confirm your settings before launching.



* * *

## 

1\. Set campaign info and choose your audience

Enter your campaign's basic information, choose a campaign type, and select your audience.

### 

Campaign info

Enter a campaign name and select the channels you want to send this campaign to. In addition, you have the option to add:

  * Tags which can be used for filtering in the [campaign list](doc:campaigns-regular-manage).
  * A campaign description.

![](https://files.readme.io/c96660d97c3aa43ea1cec671b1bb585956b6634d4b8c2717a451c2511d1f9f4a-message-campaign-name-campaign-info.png)

### 

Campaign type

Choose how the campaign should be sent and select the device platforms to deliver to.

![](https://files.readme.io/4bc649eb7df1c24bc0be0caa19334112d92ac0327d52822f62f6085dab8aeb32-message-create-campaign-type.png)   


Campaign type| Description  
---|---  
**Regular**|  Send campaigns manually or on a fixed schedule.  
**Trigger**|  Add a trigger rule to send campaigns to users who meet certain conditions, such as browsing a page or adding a product to their cart.  
  
Note that iOS trigger campaigns are only supported for apps provisioned with Apple's distribution (production) certificate.  
  
### 

Trigger rule

If you selected **Trigger** for the campaign type, set a trigger rule. When users trigger the rule, they'll receive the campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/a53c2710b50c324b2760acde2679b88335871f0bdefab0eed0058d2c696f7085-message-create-trigger-rule.png)

Rule| Description| Example use cases  
---|---|---  
**User action**|  Send the campaign after the user completes a certain action.Note that any events that satisfy event conditions can trigger the campaign, even if the event occurred before the campaign started running.| • Send a checkout reminder to users one day after adding an item to their cart if the purchase wasn't completed.• Send a new member promotion to users 10 minutes after creating an account.  
**Relative date**|  Set the campaign send time based on a user's date-based attribute, such as their birthday or membership joining date.Please note the following requirements:  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• The event or attribute parameters to be used as the trigger condition need to follow the [date format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#date-format) or [datetime format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#datetime-format).| • Send a birthday coupon a week before the user's birthday.• Send a membership anniversary discount code.  
**Feed change**|  Send the campaign to certain users when the product data feed is updated.Data feed conditions are checked once a day at the **Send time** configured in the campaign settings. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at that time.Please note the following requirements:  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• Your [product feed](doc:product-data-feed) must be onboarded.| • Send a notification to users who browsed "Product A" if that product's price is lowered by 10% (check daily at 10:00 AM).• Send a restock notification to users who added an out-of-stock product to their cart when the product is restocked (check daily at 12:00 PM).  
  
### 

Audience

Under the **Audience** section, select which segments to include and exclude from the campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/32c5a590b1527c16db8f4e59cd060d2febbc5a437efbea92925cc674e5c785a9-regular-campaign-create-audience.png)

Audience setting| Description  
---|---  
**Users to include**|  Users in this segment will receive the campaign. If no segment is selected, the value will be **All users** , and every user will receive the campaign. You can select up to 10 segments.  
**Users to exclude**|  Users in this segment won't receive the campaign. You can select up to 10 segments.  
  
For example, to send a campaign to users who didn't open your mobile app in the last 30 days:

  * **Users to include** : Don't select any segment to keep the default value of **All users**.
  * **Users to exclude** : Select a segment that contains users who have opened the app in the last 30 days.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Regular campaigns: Estimated audience size
> 
> Regular campaigns provide an estimated audience size with a margin of error of approximately 5%, so this estimate may differ slightly from numbers visible in the segment list.

* * *

## 

2\. Set up creatives

In the **Creative** section, select a creative type and complete all the required fields. For details about each creative template, see [Push Creatives](doc:creatives-push).

[ ![Android push](https://files.readme.io/997bf825aaec4b6293090aa968a394bc85cf3f924ba6494f04948d1844540f6e-Android.png) Android push ](/docs/creatives-android-push) [ ![iOS push](https://files.readme.io/06f466c44ffe80f7c9cc1a4ae43745ee2e0e23f25d9c04843fb0c3f686dca333-Ios.png) iOS push ](/docs/creatives-ios-push) [ ![Web push](https://files.readme.io/4962c5b325527e7752f186dec94f0ba92dd206b5d55ab9d101f51967490cc79a-Website.png) Web push ](/docs/creatives-web-push)

> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> Experiments: Message campaigns
> 
> Set up campaign experiments to compare different creative variants and measure campaign effectiveness. For details, see [Experiments: Message campaigns](doc:campaigns-experiments-message).

In addition, you can view previews for all web push creatives, Android standard push notifications, and iOS standard push notifications in the campaign creation screen.

![](https://files.readme.io/adccf13964a775e88756007c8450a69e283cd09693b82722907881926a12053d-regular-push-creative.png)

After setting up the creative, click **Next** to finalize your campaign's settings.

* * *

## 

3\. Configure campaign settings

  * Under **Schedule**, choose how and when to send the campaign.
  * Under **Campaign settings**, configure campaign-level settings, such as the campaign's goals and frequency cap.



### 

Schedule

In the **Schedule** section, choose how you'd like to send the campaign.

  * Regular campaigns
  * Trigger campaigns: Feed change



#### 

Regular campaigns

Schedule type| Description  
---|---  
**Manual**|  Send the campaign by manually clicking the **Send now** button from the campaign list. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/965725c99e071cfbc890608554f0cc8239fe8f403d730489e3075052f9c1545e-regular-push-schedule-manual.png)  
**One-time**|  Send the campaign at a specific date and time. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/6d148d4f33a21f88846560fd7b3bedde983ded94456e0592dcee3b305d745ea1-regular-push-schedule-one-time.png)  
**Recurring**|  Specify the first campaign send time as well as the time interval (in days) for resending the campaign.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/b5b8e37be19d6121dea7da51da93d896f7c3454189ca064f7693fc777ed717f3-regular-push-schedule-recurring.png)  
  
#### 

Trigger campaigns: Feed change

**Send time** determines when the data feed is checked each day. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at this time. This setting is only available when the trigger rule is set to **Feed change**.

![](https://files.readme.io/89abea265eeabbcb566f154ce3881264ed8e4f1f898ffd5ff48ed5e97b0980fa-message-trigger-send-time.png)

### 

Campaign settings

The **Campaign settings** section contains settings for goal events, time to live, and frequency cap.

Campaign setting| Description  
---|---  
**Set campaign goals**|  Enabling this setting allows you to select events that will override the [account-level conversion events](doc:user-settings#conversion-and-attribution) for this campaign.   
In the campaign performance page of this campaign, conversion-related metrics will be calculated based on goal events instead of the account-level conversion events.  
**Set time to live**|  Set a lifespan for your Android, iOS, and web push campaign notifications. Setting a time to live (TTL) is useful for time-sensitive campaigns, for example, limited time sales. If no value is specified, the TTL is set to that maximum length of 28 days.   
For example, if a campaign is sent at 5 PM with a TTL of 2 hours, only users whose devices are connected to the notification service between 5 PM and 7 PM will receive the notification. Possible reasons that could prevent a device from connecting to the notification service include:   
• The device being powered off  
• The device being in power saving mode  
• The device having no network connection  
Note that a [blackout window](doc:user-settings#blackout-window) will override the TTL. For example, if you’ve configured a blackout window starting at 10 PM and sent a campaign at 9 PM with a TTL of 3 hours, the campaign's TTL would be reduced from 3 hours to an hour due to the blackout window.  
**Bypass frequency cap**|  Only available if the campaign type is set to **Regular**.• Disabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval for regular campaigns will be applied.   
• Enabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval will be ignored. Select this option to override all frequency caps for important messages.   
Learn more about the notification frequency cap in [Account settings](doc:user-settings#notification-frequency-cap).  
  
* * *

## 

4\. Review & launch

Finally, review and confirm your campaign settings. When you're ready to launch the campaign, click **Publish**.

![](https://files.readme.io/db8d2d44188ad2e5a565164e47edc8929101e7b74b3665583398572baf0134fa-push-campaign-review.png)

If you created a trigger campaign (**Campaign Type** set to **Trigger**), you'll need to enable the campaign from the campaign list—only campaigns with an **Active** status will be sent when trigger conditions are met.

![](https://files.readme.io/58c703b42c00fdfd820af176eafe7f9da52c61c75028e0b78da37bf5bd9688e9-message-trigger-enable.png)

# SMS/MMS

Create SMS and MMS campaigns.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Before you begin
> 
> Complete the [SMS/MMS channel setup](doc:campaigns-getting-started-sms-mms) before creating a campaign.

To create an SMS/MMS campaign, go to **Campaigns > Message campaigns**, click **\+ Create campaign** , and select **SMS/MMS**.

![](https://files.readme.io/1cc0031460659daa774d0c6a61a26922c5c9b654687e63ab2d8a0df5209f5ff3-message-campaigns-create.png)

Next, complete the campaign settings.

  1. Audience: Set campaign info and choose your audience.
  2. Creative: Design campaign creatives and variants.
  3. Settings: Set campaign-level settings, such as the schedule and campaign goals.
  4. Review & launch: Confirm your settings before launching.



* * *

## 

1\. Set campaign info and choose your audience

Enter your campaign's basic information, choose a campaign type, and select your audience.

### 

Campaign info

Enter a campaign name and optionally, add tags which can be used for filtering in the [campaign list](doc:campaigns-message-manage).

![](https://files.readme.io/1c1dbfb1c7cc7177bbea11eea7872c92aed2b1f90bf2bcff74cfcb82bff31f07-regular-sms-campaign-info.png)

### 

Campaign type

Choose how the campaign should be sent. If you're creating a **Trigger** campaign, select which platform's events to use as campaign triggers.

![](https://files.readme.io/4bc649eb7df1c24bc0be0caa19334112d92ac0327d52822f62f6085dab8aeb32-message-create-campaign-type.png)

Campaign type| Description  
---|---  
**Regular**|  Send campaigns manually or on a fixed schedule.  
**Trigger**|  Add a trigger rule to send campaigns users meet certain conditions, such as browsing a page or adding a product to their cart.  
  
### 

Trigger rule

If you selected **Trigger** for the campaign type, set a trigger rule. When users trigger the rule, they'll receive the campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/a53c2710b50c324b2760acde2679b88335871f0bdefab0eed0058d2c696f7085-message-create-trigger-rule.png)

Rule| Description| Example use cases  
---|---|---  
**User action**|  Send the campaign after the user completes a certain action.Note that any events that satisfy event conditions can trigger the campaign, even if the event occurred before the campaign started running.| • Send a checkout reminder to users one day after adding an item to their cart if the purchase wasn't completed.• Send a new member promotion to users 10 minutes after creating an account.  
**Relative date**|  Set the campaign send time based on a user's date-based attribute, such as their birthday or membership joining date.Please note the following requirements:  
  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• The event or attribute parameters to be used as the trigger condition need to follow the [date format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#date-format) or [datetime format](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/passing-dates-and-times-to-aiqua-servers#datetime-format).| • Send a birthday coupon a week before the user's birthday.• Send a membership anniversary discount code.  
**Feed change**|  Send the campaign to certain users when the product data feed is updated.Data feed conditions are checked once a day at the **Send time** configured in the campaign settings. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at that time.Please note the following requirements:  
  
• This feature needs to be activated by Appier Support.  
• Your [product feed](doc:product-data-feed) must be onboarded.| • Send a notification to users who browsed "Product A" if that product's price is lowered by 10% (check daily at 10:00 AM).• Send a restock notification to users who added an out-of-stock product to their cart when it's restocked (check daily at 12:00 PM).  
  
### 

Audience

Under the **Audience** section, choose which users to include and exclude:

![](https://files.readme.io/20eb70ce92e671b44589905a865a3caa9c75d5adf5ab1e385a0db77093e1621c-regular-sms-audience.png)

Audience setting| Description  
---|---  
**Users to include**|  Users in this segment will receive the campaign. Select up to 10 segments. If no segment is selected, all users with valid phone numbers will receive the campaign.  
**Users to exclude**|  Users in this segment won't receive the campaign. Select up to 10 segments.  
  
For example, to only send the campaign to users who were active in the last 90 days:

  * **Users to include** : Keep the default value of **All users** without selecting any segment.
  * **Users to exclude** : Select a segment containing users who had no activity in the last 90 days.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Regular campaigns: Estimated audience size
> 
> Regular campaigns provide an estimated audience size with a margin of error of approximately 5%, so this estimate may differ slightly from numbers visible in the segment list.

* * *

## 

2\. Set up creatives

In the **Creative** section, select **SMS** or **MMS**.

![](https://files.readme.io/ddbec848df70f00682753900853662a4fc1454e97e90eada8c4c449d0c57d76a-regular-create-sms-mms-creative.png)

  * [**SMS**](doc:creatives-sms-mms#standard-sms-specifications): A text-only message.
  * [**MMS**](doc:creatives-sms-mms#mms-specifications): A message that contains a subject line and attached media, such as an image or GIF. Supported media file types: GIF, JPG, JPEG, PNG.
  * [**LMS**](doc:creatives-sms-mms#lms-specifications) (Only supported in South Korea): SMS messages exceeding 90 characters are automatically converted to an LMS, and the **LMS subject** field will become available. The LMS subject is displayed before the message in brackets.

![](https://files.readme.io/3dbcbc835d6b3196f44d2e3d55ef28f6564a306fd420d1fcde111cd8fecfce58-LMS-subject.png)

* * *

## 

3\. Configure campaign settings

  * Under **Schedule**, choose how and when to send the campaign.
  * Under **Campaign settings**, configure campaign-level settings, such as the campaign's goals and frequency cap.



### 

Schedule

In the **Schedule** section, choose how you'd like to send the campaign.

  * Regular campaigns
  * Trigger campaigns: Feed change



#### 

Regular campaigns

Schedule type| Description  
---|---  
**Manual**|  Send the campaign by manually clicking the **Send now** button from the campaign list. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/965725c99e071cfbc890608554f0cc8239fe8f403d730489e3075052f9c1545e-regular-push-schedule-manual.png)  
**One-time**|  Send the campaign at a specific date and time. [Send time optimization](doc:campaigns-message#send-time-optimization) is supported for this option.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/6d148d4f33a21f88846560fd7b3bedde983ded94456e0592dcee3b305d745ea1-regular-push-schedule-one-time.png)  
**Recurring**|  Specify the first campaign send time as well as the time interval (in days) for resending the campaign.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/b5b8e37be19d6121dea7da51da93d896f7c3454189ca064f7693fc777ed717f3-regular-push-schedule-recurring.png)  
  
#### 

Trigger campaign: Feed change

**Send time** determines when the data feed is checked each day. If conditions are satisfied, the campaign will be sent at this time. This setting is only available when the trigger rule is set to **Feed change**.

![](https://files.readme.io/89abea265eeabbcb566f154ce3881264ed8e4f1f898ffd5ff48ed5e97b0980fa-message-trigger-send-time.png)

### 

Campaign settings

The **Campaign settings** section contains settings for goal events, time to live, and frequency cap.

Setting| Description  
---|---  
**Set campaign goals**|  Enabling this setting allows you to select events that will override the [account-level conversion events](doc:user-settings#conversion-and-attribution) for this campaign.   
In the campaign performance page of this campaign, conversion-related metrics will be calculated based on goal events instead of the account-level conversion events.  
**Bypass frequency cap**|  Only available if the campaign type is set to **Regular**.• Disabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval for regular campaigns will be applied.   
• Enabled: Both the daily limit and minimum interval will be ignored. Select this option to override all frequency caps for important messages.   
Learn more about the notification frequency cap in [Account settings](doc:user-settings#notification-frequency-cap).  
  
* * *

## 

4\. Review & launch

Finally, review and confirm your campaign settings. When you're ready to launch the campaign, click **Publish**.

![](https://files.readme.io/a3498158850e3257ab4b5002f0f7f9ee1fb8840ab5fc7cfc2444c6597481679e-sms-create-review-and-launch.png)

If you created a trigger campaign (**Campaign Type** set to **Trigger**), you'll need to enable the campaign from the campaign list—only campaigns with an **Active** status will be sent when trigger conditions are met.

![](https://files.readme.io/58c703b42c00fdfd820af176eafe7f9da52c61c75028e0b78da37bf5bd9688e9-message-trigger-enable.png)

# Managing Message Campaigns

View performance and perform actions for your message campaigns.

You can view and manage your message campaigns from the campaign list (**Campaigns > Message campaigns**). In addition to searching and filtering existing campaigns, you can perform operations such as manually sending campaigns, viewing the campaign's performance page, and exporting reports.

  * Search and filter campaigns
  * Perform campaign operations
  * View campaign performance

![](https://files.readme.io/82649b49a05f9b76e0865e741ab46321af024a98c7c5d751082f12b461db072d-message-manage-campaign-list.png)

* * *

## 

Search and filter campaigns

From the campaign list, you can search campaigns and apply various filters to view a more focused set of campaigns.

### 

Search

Enter search terms to find campaigns by name or ID.

![](https://files.readme.io/6f43322ccd632fbef520def8cf63c13431b33746e62a79fe07b40812ea3a23b3-message-manage-search.png)

### 

Filter

Use the provided filter options to streamline campaign list results.

![](https://files.readme.io/76e78f4c5e36a4ee66c227aa2fd0c7d2ce3363f53c3c0373c9a2a7cbb76361cd-message-manage-tags.png)

Filter option| Description  
---|---  
**Channel**|  Select a campaign channel like **Push** or **Email**.  
**Status**|  Select one of the following campaign statuses:• **Draft** : The campaign hasn't been manually sent yet. Not applicable to campaigns on a one-time or recurring schedule. Select this option to quickly identify campaigns ready for manual sending.• **Scheduled** : The campaign is scheduled to run in the future.• **Completed** : The campaign has finished sending.• **Archived** : The campaign has been archived.  
**Type**|  Select one more regular or trigger campaign types from the dropdown.  
**Tag**|  Select one or more tags from the dropdown.  
  
* * *

## 

Perform campaign operations

From the campaign list, you can access campaign actions by clicking the three vertical dots next to the campaign's name.

![](https://files.readme.io/a2307462e55f58517b3eb90861946ca0d6c6326edc885bf04971a7d5d2776579-message-manage-actions.png)

The following actions are available for message campaigns.

Campaign action| Description  
---|---  
**Edit**|  Edit campaign settings.  
**Schedule**|  Set a campaign delivery schedule.  
**Duplicate**|  Duplicate the campaign. The duplicated campaign's name will be the original campaign's name with "`-copy`" appended.  
**Send now**|  Manually send the campaign.  
**Modify tags**|  Add and remove tags for this campaign.  
**View Activity Logs**|  View logs detailing operations performed on this campaign.  
**Export user report**|  Export a user report containing data about users who interacted with or received this campaign.  
**Export click report**|  Only supported for [email campaigns](doc:campaigns-message-create-email). Export a [click report](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-export-email-click-reports) showing which links in your email were clicked and how often. Contact your customer success manager to enable this feature.  
**Archive**|  Archive the campaign. Archived campaigns aren't displayed in the campaign list unless the status filter is set to include campaigns with the **Archived** status.  
  
### 

Enable and disable trigger campaigns

Trigger campaigns can be enabled and disabled from the campaign list. Only campaigns with an **Active** status will be sent when trigger conditions are met.

![](https://files.readme.io/58c703b42c00fdfd820af176eafe7f9da52c61c75028e0b78da37bf5bd9688e9-message-trigger-enable.png)

* * *

## 

View campaign performance

You can view performance data using:

  * Campaign list metrics
  * The campaign's performance page
  * Exportable reports



### 

Campaign list metrics

![](https://files.readme.io/b911d19374a5492cefd4eb16df41e2749415131db068524ef82f1a5295b16108-message-manage-metrics.png)

The following metrics and campaign details visible from the campaign list:

Metric| Description  
---|---  
**Runs**|  The number of campaign runs. Each run refers to a single instance of sending the campaign.  
**Total sent**|  The total number of notifications sent by AIQUA.  
**Delivered**|  The number of times this campaign has been delivered via email, SMS, and Kakao, as reported by their respective vendors.  
**Impressions**|  An impression is counted when a user receives a push (app or web), in-web, or in-app campaign notification on their device. This is based on the number of `notification_received` events.For example, if the campaign is sent to an audience with 50K users, and only 30K users receive it on their devices, then the number of impressions is 30K.  
**Opens**|  The number of times the email was opened.  
**Open rate**|  The open rate for email campaigns.  
**Clicks**|  The number of times users click on the campaign based on the number of `notification_clicked` events.  
**CTR**|  The click-through rate of the campaign until its end date. Calculated using (Clicks / Impressions) x 100%.  
**Conv. count**|  The count of online conversion events until the campaign's end date. This is based on the attribution settings and conversion events you selected in your account settings.  
**Conv. value**|  The monetary value associated with online conversion events.For example, if the conversion event is `checkout_completed`, the **CONV. value** represents the sum of the conversion values of all `checkout_completed` events attributed to the campaign.  
**Offline conv. count**|  The count of offline conversion events uploaded through [Offline Event API v2](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/reference/getting-starting-with-the-offline-event-api-v2). This is based on the attribution settings you selected in your account settings.  
**Offline conv. value**|  The monetary value of all offline conversion events attributed to the campaign.  
**Include segments**|  Segments selected to receive this campaign. Hover over this column to view the full list of included segments.  
**Exclude segments**|  Segments excluded from receiving this campaign. Hover over this column to view the full list of excluded segments.  
**Next scheduled time**|  If the campaign has been scheduled for the future, this column displays the date and time of the run, otherwise, this column will be empty.  
**Last sent time**|  The last time the campaign was run.  
**Last edited**|  The last time the campaign was edited.  
  
### 

Campaign performance page

Click on the campaign's name to open its performance page. For more details, see [View Performance](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-view-performance).

![](https://files.readme.io/182b80ac3e2a6db5d2ca638212eb200cbf89e515da1fa06cb2129367094adaf2-message-manage-campaign-performance-page.png)

### 

Exportable reports

  * Campaign performance report
  * User report
  * Email click report



#### 

Campaign performance report

Campaign performance reports contain campaign details and performance metrics, and can be exported to a CSV file and downloaded via URL sent to your email address. For details about what data the campaign performance report includes, see [Export Campaign Performance Reports](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-export-campaign-performance-reports#report-columns).

To export a campaign performance report, click **Export report**.

![](https://files.readme.io/67bf51b433d2da5f941b3a3d982a35798f8a48b5c0782d61d972a35844388818-message-manage-export-report.png)

#### 

User report

User reports contain data about users who interacted with or received this campaign, including their user ID, email address, and whether they performed certain actions, such as opening or clicking on a campaign. For more details about the data contained in user reports, see [Export Campaign User Reports](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-export-campaign-user-reports).

To export a user report, click the three vertical dots to open the list of available campaign actions, then click **Export user report**. You'll receive an email containing a download URL for the report CSV file.

![](https://files.readme.io/70df05515f98f18144b04e676d1ff9488520fed9e771b01d7c837c728456b7db-message-export-user-report.png)

#### 

Email click report

Export the click report from email campaigns to see which links were clicked and how often. Reports are generated as CSV files and delivered via email. For details about limitations and report data, see [Export Email Click Report](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-export-email-click-reports).

![](https://files.readme.io/101af4b1c7b88b97c151eea5a96442a3f91a722d342b33ae280588e510c990b0-export-click-report-list.png)

# Can I also trigger a fake prompt for users who aren’t opted-in?

Yes. You can do this by calling `appier("prompt-push")` in the Appier web SDK.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note:
> 
> Unsubscribed users, or users who disabled web notifications on their device, wouldn’t get the fake prompt.

# Configuring Batching for the iOS SDK

To optimize network usage, the Appier iOS SDK batches the network requests it makes to the AIQUA server. By default, it flushes data to the server **every 15 seconds** in release builds, and **every second** in debug builds.

You can configure your preferred `BATCH_INTERVAL` (in seconds) using this method:

SwiftObjective-C
    
    
    QGSdk.getSharedInstance().flushInterval = BATCH_INTERVAL
    
    
    [[QGSdk getSharedInstance] setFlushInterval:BATCH_INTERVAL];

To force the Appier SDK to flush the data to the server at any time, call:

SwiftObjective-C
    
    
    QGSdk.getSharedInstance().flush()
    
    
    [[QGSdk getSharedInstance] flush];

To invoke a completion handler after flush, use:

SwiftObjective-C
    
    
    QGSdk.getSharedInstance().flush(completion: {
      //some method
    })
    
    
    [[QGSdk getSharedInstance] flushWithCompletion:^{
      //some method
    }];

# Android SDK Batching

## 

Appier Android SDK batching

To optimize network usage, the Appier SDK batches its network requests to AIQUA's server when ever one of the following conditions are met:

  * 15 seconds have passed since data was last sent to AIQUA's servers
  * The number of user events stored by the SDK exceeds 100
  * The `flush()` API is called, forcing the SDK to upload all stored data



Unless one of the conditions stated above are met, the SDK will continue to collect and store data, including user events and attributes, without uploading it to AIQUA's servers.

* * *

## 

Force-flushing stored data

You can force the SDK to flush all stored data to AIQUA's servers at any time by calling `flush()`:

JavaKotlin
    
    
    QG.getInstance(context).flush();
    
    
    QG.getInstance(context).flush()

# Creating Journey Maps (Legacy)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Legacy feature
> 
> The legacy journey maps feature will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using the [latest journey maps](https://docs.enterprise.appier.com/docs/getting-started-with-journey-maps) for a more intuitive journey builder and better cross-channel integration. Contact your customer success manager for more details.

Below are the steps to create a journey map. There is a [sample use case](doc:creating-customer-journey-maps#section-sample-use-case) at the end.

## 

1\. Create a New Journey Map

Go to **Campaigns** , select **Journey Maps** , and then click the **Create New Map** button. Type a map name.

![](https://files.readme.io/0f8dd96-Screen_Shot_2021-03-27_at_3.34.10_PM.png)   


## 

2\. Select Target Audience

Select the user segment you want to include and exclude.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note:
> 
> AIQUA updates the campaign audience once per hour, so it may take up to one hour for users to be included in the segment after they meet that segment's conditions.

  1. Click **Create**.

![](https://files.readme.io/69b8dbe-Screen_Shot_2020-02-14_at_5.56.06_PM.png)

  2. Select an audience segment to **Include**.
  3. Select an audience segment to **Exclude** (optional).
  4. Click **Create**.

  


## 

3\. Set an Entry Action (Optional)

If you set an event as the entry action, users from your target audience need to complete the entry action to proceed to the next step.

  1. Click the + icon, select **Entry Action** and click **Create**.
  2. Click **Add Events** and select an event. For example, `product_viewed`.
  3. If needed, click **Add Filter** and set the associated parameters. For example, `category_name` of the product viewed needs to contain "shoes".

![](https://files.readme.io/2849c97-Screen_Shot_2021-05-14_at_2.00.03_PM.png)

  4. Click **Update**.

  


## 

4\. Add Conditions

You can select an event as the condition, where users will only go to the next step if they complete the event. Multiple events can be set with each event leading to a different notification or condition.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note:
> 
> The following events cannot be used as a trigger condition in Journey Maps: `first_app_launched`, `first_visited`, and `app_uninstalled`.

There are two types of condition:

  * **Wait for events to happen** : AIQUA waits for users to complete the event before going to the next step.
  * **Based on past events** : AIQUA examines users' events from the past X days and users who have completed the events will proceed to the next step. Only events that happen after the entry action are considered.



### 

Setting Up Conditions

  1. Click the add icon, select **Add Conditions** and select **Wait for events to happen** or **Based on past events**.
  2. Click **Create**.
  3. Click **Add Events** to select an event and optionally click **Add Filter** to add associated event parameters.
  4. If you want to set multiple scenarios, click **Add New Scenario** and repeat the step above.
  5. Specify the time duration.
     * If you have selected **Based on past events** , you can adjust the time of **in the last X days** to look for event completion in the past X days.
     * If you have selected **Wait for events to happen** , specify the **Time duration to wait for events to happen**.
  6. Click **Update** when done.

![](https://files.readme.io/cac992e-Screen_Shot_2020-02-15_at_11.34.21_AM.png)   


## 

5\. Add Notifications

Set the notification you want to send.

  1. Click the add icon to select a message type.
  2. Click **Create**.
  3. Type a campaign name and set the creatives. Different types of creative are available based on the type of notification selected. Refer to [Creatives](doc:creatives) for more details.

  


## 

6\. Utilize Other Features

### 

Adjust Timing Between Boxes

Between boxes, you can click the Timer icon to postpone proceeding to the next step.

![](https://files.readme.io/3d1a2be-Screen_Shot_2020-02-15_at_12.04.39_PM.png)

There are three options available:

  * **Immediately** \- Proceed to the next step immediately.
  * **Delay** \- Wait X days before proceeding to the next step. For example, if the user enters this phase on July 1 at 9 pm and you are delaying the push for 1 day, the user will receive the push on July 2nd at 9 pm.
  * **Delay and send at certain time** \- Wait X **calendar** days and proceed to the next step at the indicated time. For example, if the user enters this phase on July 1 at 9 pm, and the timer setting is 11 am after one day, the user will move to the next step on July 2 at 11 am.

![](https://files.readme.io/431070f-Screen_Shot_2020-08-13_at_4.32.04_PM.png)   


### 

Drag and Connect

If you need to make changes to the journey map, you can delete a box or delete a link between boxes, and then link unconnected boxes using one of these methods:

  * Click the add icon and drag the **Drag and Connect** option.
  * Click and hold the add icon to drag to another box.

![](https://files.readme.io/2803cdc-GIF_Journey_drag5.gif)   


## 

7\. Exit the Users

It is required to specify how the users will exit the journey.

  * Each route in the journey map must end with an Exit box. Click the add icon and select **Exit the Users**.
  * You need to set an overall **Exit Criteria**.



### 

Exit Criteria

Exit Criteria override all conditions in the map. For example, if the goal of the journey is to encourage purchase, you can exit the users when they make a purchase. Another common practice is to set a maximum number of notifications received to be the exit criteria to prevent users from receiving too many notifications.

To set exit criteria:

  1. Click the **Edit** button next to Exit Criteria at the bottom.

![](https://files.readme.io/72bb798-Screen_Shot_2020-02-20_at_3.10.52_PM.png)

  2. Click **Add Events** to select an event as the exit criteria and optionally click **Add Filter** to add associated event parameters.
  3. You can click **Add New Condition** to have more than one criteria. Users exit the journey if they fulfill any one of the exit criteria.
  4. If needed, select **Allow user to re-enter the journey up to X times** and set a limit for how many times the users can enter the journey if they complete the entry action again.
  5. Click **Save**.

  


## 

8\. Activate the Journey

When you are done with setting up the journey map, click **Save**. You will see the created campaign in the Journey Maps List.

  * If you want to manually start running the journey map, set the switch to ON when you are ready to activate it.
  * If you want to set a schedule to activate the journey map, select **Schedule** to set the Start Time and End Time. Next, set the switch to ON and the journey map will start running based on your scheduled time.

![](https://files.readme.io/294d00a-Screen_Shot_2021-05-14_at_11.45.53_AM.png)   


## 

Sample Use Case

Let's say you run an English learning website that offers online lessons for paid members. Your goal is to encourage users to sign up for membership. Using Web Push, you offer a free lesson to interested users. If the user takes the free lesson, membership discount is offered to encourage signup. If the user didn't accept the lesson, you offer another free lesson.

This use case can be set up as shown below:

![](https://files.readme.io/305f284-Screen_Shot_2020-02-15_at_6.57.36_PM.png)

For this use case, the Exit Criteria can be set to membership signup. If the user subscribes to membership at any point, they will be exited from the journey.

# Creative Elements

This guide introduces creative elements available in Creative Studio, including images, videos, and more. Each element is explained with its relevant settings, styles, and actions, to help you customize it to fit your campaign.

  * Button
  * Checkbox
  * Input fields
  * Radio
  * Drop-down list
  * Text element
  * Image
  * Video
  * Custom content
  * Wheel of fortune



* * *

## 

Button

__Button

Add clickable buttons that trigger actions in your creative.

  


**Settings**

Setting| Description  
---|---  
Element name| A unique identifier for the button within your creative.  
Button text| The text displayed on the button.  
Accessibility label| A short description of the button for users relying on assistive technology.  
Placement| Controls for position, size, offset, and rotation of the button.  
Animation| Configure entrance animation and delay options.  
  
  


**Styles**

Style| Description  
---|---  
Opacity| Adjust the transparency of the entire button element.  
Character| Font type, size, color, and alignment settings for button text.  
Background| Options for fill color or background image of the button.  
Borders| Controls for border radius, color, and thickness of the button.  
Rounded corners| Set the curvature for the button corners.  
Shadow| Customization for shadow color, offset, blur, and spread.  
Hover styles| Appearance when the user hovers over the button.  
Active styles| Look of the button when clicked.  
Disabled styles| Appearance when the button is inactive.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/bc753ed067c3105feb7c80acae0e91d664156d39474fb8dcba0b6f4ff872e5c1-Button.png)

  


**Actions**

Tab| Description| Supported conditions  
---|---|---  
Check| Conditions that must be met before an action is performed.| • View inputs are valid  
• Custom data field equals  
• Custom data field not equals  
• Have value  
• Value equals  
• Value not equals  
• Input is valid  
Action| Operations that occur after check conditions are met.| • Change view  
• Exit  
• Submit form  
• URL redirect  
• Run JavaScript  
• Show/hide element  
• Delay  
• Run workflow  
• Change variable  
  
  


> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> See best practices for setting up an [interactive button element](doc:designing-creatives#discount-banner-example).

* * *

## 

Checkbox

__Checkbox

Use checkboxes to select multiple options or indicate true/false choices.

  


**Settings**

Setting| Description  
---|---  
Element name| A unique identifier for the checkbox within your creative.  
Checkbox text| The text displayed next to the checkbox.  
Accessibility label| A short description of the checkbox for users relying on assistive technology.  
Placement| Controls for position, size, offset, and rotation of the checkbox.  
Animation| Configure entrance animation and delay options.  
  
  


**Styles**

Style| Description  
---|---  
Opacity| Adjust the transparency of the checkbox element.  
Character| Font type, size, color, and alignment settings for checkbox labels.  
Background| Options for fill color or background image of the checkbox area.  
Borders| Controls for border radius, color, and thickness of the checkbox.  
Shadow| Customization for shadow color, offset, blur, and spread.  
Mark styles| Customize the appearance of selected and unselected states.

# Creative Studio

Creative Studio allows you to build interactive in-web and in-app creatives using a simple drag-and-drop interface—no coding required. It's possible to design complex, multistep creatives with Creative Studio.

For example, you can:

  * Display personalized [product recommendations](doc:prebuilt-templates#recommendation).
  * Ask visitors to [fill out a survey](doc:prebuilt-templates#slider-surveys) and display a coupon code as a reward upon completion.
  * [Spin a lucky wheel](doc:prebuilt-templates#lucky-wheel) to win a prize or offer.



Start by building a template from new scratch in Creative Studio or by customizing a [prebuilt template](doc:prebuilt-templates). After creating a template, you'll be able to select it in the campaign creation process.

![Creative Studio Overview](https://files.readme.io/a7625dc-Screen_Shot_2021-09-17_at_2.45.31_PM.png)

* * *

## 

Requirements and compatibility

### 

In-web campaigns

#### 

Browser compatibility

To ensure Creative Studio displays correctly for in-web campaigns, use a supported browser when accessing it on the AIQUA dashboard.

Supported browsers| Unsupported  
---|---  
• Chrome  
• Firefox| • Internet Explorer   
• Safari   
• Any browsers in incognito mode  
  
### 

In-app campaigns

#### 

Required Appier SDK versions

Creative Studio in-app campaigns are supported by the following Appier SDKs:

  * Android SDK 7.24.0 or later
  * iOS SDK 7.31.0 or later



Use Recommendation with Creative Studio in-app campaigns by following these Appier SDK versions:

  * iOS SDK 7.32.2 or later
  * Android SDK 7.24.1 or later



#### 

Required WebView versions

For in-app campaigns created with Creative Studio to display correctly, the following WebView versions are required on the user's device.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> For Android devices, the corresponding OS versions listed below include the required WebView versions by default. Devices running earlier OS versions may still meet the requirements if users have updated their device's WebView version.

Platform| Required WebView versions| Corresponding OS versions  
---|---|---  
Android| WebView 66.0.3359.158 or later| Android 9 or later (OS versions with required WebView built-in)  
iOS| WKWebView 12.0 or later| iOS 12 or later  
  
#### 

Limitations for in-app campaigns

  * **Background overlay** : When using Creative Studio with in-app campaigns, you can choose to enable a gray background overlay. When the overlay is enabled, users must close the campaign to interact with the app again.
    * On iOS devices, if the campaign content fails to load, the overlay will disappear, which may create a screen flashing effect.
  * **Landscape mode** : When a mobile device is in landscape mode, the creative content may shrink to fit the limited screen size.
  * **On-screen keyboard** : When entering information in an in-app campaign, for example, when filling out a lead generation form, the on-screen keyboard may overlap the creative depending on the app's configuration.
  * **Screen orientation change** : On Android devices, video playback is paused when the screen is rotated and might not automatically resume depending on the app's configuration.

  * [Exploring Creative Studio](doc:exploring-creative-studio)
  * [Designing Creatives](doc:designing-creatives)

# FAQs

  * Why can't videos autoplay when the user views the campaign, even if the "Autoplay" setting is enabled?
  * Why can't I see the destination page when I click a link in the creative preview?
  * How do I control the position of the creative on my website or app?
  * In the interaction report, why are the numbers different in the Stats panel?



* * *

## 

Why can't videos autoplay when the user views the campaign, even if the "Autoplay" setting is enabled?

Some browsers block videos from autoplaying when they're not muted. To avoid this issue, select both the **Autoplay** and **Play muted** boxes to allow autoplay to work more consistently.

![](https://files.readme.io/dc9eeba8339dc6a03779af446f476def5a4f0385e48a06b10243f69ec516a02c-Frame_6.png)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> In some mobile environments, YouTube videos won't autoplay until the user interacts with the video, regardless of the settings you've chosen. For details, see [YouTube's IFrame API documentation](https://developers.google.com/youtube/iframe_api_reference#Autoplay_and_scripted_playback).

* * *

## 

Why can't I see the destination page when I click a link in the creative preview?

When previewing the creative in the campaign setup page, you might click on a redirect URL in the creative preview. For example, you might click on a "Shop Now" button that redirects to your product page.

If the destination page blocks iframes, the redirect URL will not display in the preview window. Users will not encounter this issue when they click on the actual creative, but in the preview, you will see an error like this:

![](https://files.readme.io/0ec9f1c312f9d9298fd840921b5ad7964f390fcb3b9092d9f3ce9df602eee4cf-creative-studio-faq-1.gif)

For in-web campaigns, if you want to return to the creative preview again from an error page or a destination page, you can click the **Desktop** or **Mobile** tab. For in-app campaigns, you can refresh the page.

![](https://files.readme.io/6107ffb9133273e5e8f8dc82e6a5d44ed2081f2fc962d88fcea94626eabd46f1-CS-switch-device.png)

* * *

## 

How do I control the position of the creative on my website or app?

To control the position of the creative on your website or app, go to **Settings > Placement** in the creative view.

First, click the creative view at the bottom of the page, then select the view name under the **Elements** tab.

![](https://files.readme.io/45b8e43ffaaf1c61a1294d0f7c8844e282d806ad39f37efd37b94d6573b186a7-Group_12.png)

Under the **Settings > Placement** section of the creative view, you can use the following settings to control the position of the creative.

  * **Anchored** : Click on one of the nine boxes to set the position of the creative on the website or app.
  * **Offset** : Set the creative's distance from the website edge.

![](https://files.readme.io/1dedacd4d47a1e6d23751824dc9cbf338fb9912ae5a1d93f293a1773685e4de2-Group_11.png)

If you have multiple views in a creative, you will have to repeat the same steps for each view.

* * *

## 

In the interaction report, why are the numbers different in the statistics panel?

In the interaction report, the numbers in the interaction flow shows the performance of the current creative version.

If you have made different versions of your creative, you might see different performance numbers in the **Stats** panel on the right. In the **Stats** panel, the numbers include the combined overall performance of all creative versions.

![](https://files.readme.io/e05c58fe2693c95c894a4b89580eb4e1b7e1609a1d95d3d0b01573a6748f5a4e-cs-faq-different-number.png)

To view the performance of a previous creative version in the interaction flow, select the drop-down list in the top-left corner and choose a version.

![](https://files.readme.io/1e09ed7ffbe4680cf30484ae7202cf2d9715b48534412e4c26d23358667b1783-cs-faq-version-history.png)

# My Templates

Using My Templates, you can build creative templates and reuse these templates in different campaigns. A variety of premade default templates are provided to help you quickly get started. You can also choose to build creative templates from scratch.

Currently, this feature is supported in the following campaign types:

  * **In-web campaigns built using Creative Studio** : See [Creative Studio](doc:creative-studio).
  * **Email campaigns** : See [Email Templates](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/email-templates).



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> This feature is not supported in email campaigns inside legacy journey maps.

# Creatives

In AIQUA, a creative refers to the appearance of the actual notification sent to your users in a campaign. Different campaign types offer different template types of creative. Each creative type can consist of different components, such as images, text, and call-to-action buttons.

![](https://files.readme.io/c14f7801ec0fe8dd7e8a5ed8310f2998e75a5d81dc558f5ccb67fa1287ea5f4d-creative-sample.png)

Select a channel below to view the template types supported for your campaigns.

[ ![Push](https://files.readme.io/90c61bfc6f0028f651f343f7471619155707f6e5125d72e951176dec8d030720-Campaign.png) Push ](/docs/creatives-push) [ ![In-app creatives](https://files.readme.io/8f8b89d56fbe0d41d02fa61d1e1909ca1ed18e452a9c632543df94519afde5c2-In-app_campaign.png) In-app ](/docs/campaigns-in-app-create#pop-up-creatives) [ ![In-web creatives](https://files.readme.io/768cb4180dc0dbc0a7adb8b6ab0db460d5ee03f138f7b3e6a808a2cb2838843c-Web_Subscribers.png) In-web ](/docs/campaigns-in-web-create#9-select-a-creative) [ ![Email creatives](https://files.readme.io/ab6dcf2217131f9965e515b696f5229bd5615d8c54e7c7670c342ad9c4c94509-Mail.png) Email ](/docs/creatives-email) [ ![SMS/MMS creatives](https://files.readme.io/10188113e00cd907230e1b68bf23499b6943297c8f6c3714b589a936d253e7b6-SMS.png) SMS/MMS ](/docs/creatives-sms-mms) [ ![LINE creatives](https://files.readme.io/aa8cd57fab5f7b421d8c3b928c3a507cd5fd9aaae3d9b8e739dae61b15a5d681-LINE.png) LINE ](/docs/creatives-line) [ ![Kakao creatives](https://files.readme.io/b33abe057f05b53ec7eb5da1a9879758c5e46e9170ae2f7c027e5e3809400705-KaKao_Talk.png) Kakao Moment ](/docs/creatives-kakao-moment) [ ![Kakao creatives](https://files.readme.io/b33abe057f05b53ec7eb5da1a9879758c5e46e9170ae2f7c027e5e3809400705-KaKao_Talk.png) Kakao (Chingu Talk) ](/docs/creatives-kakao-chingutalk)

* * *

## 

Dynamic content

AIQUA supports personalizing creatives using variables that change based on each user's behaviors and attributes. To learn more, see [Dynamic Content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives).

* * *

## 

Emoji

AIQUA supports using emojis in push campaigns on iOS, Android, macOS, or Windows platforms.

Platform| Supported OS versions  
---|---  
Windows| • Windows 7 and Windows 8 need the **KB2729094** patch. To learn more, see this [guide](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/2729094/an-update-for-the-segoe-ui-symbol-font-in-windows-7-and-in-windows-ser).  
• Windows 10 or later  
Android| Android 4.1 (Jelly Bean) or later  
macOS| macOS 10.10 (Yosemite) or later  
iOS| iOS 6 or later  
  
* * *

## 

Test creative

To preview the creative before sending it to users, click **Send test creative**. This sends the test notification to all devices in your **Test segment**.

![](https://files.readme.io/1c769b260886eeb1b8a670ac51b8a1a8a3dbf63a534c1dcc4a4fe869b306c5d2-test-creative.png)

## 

Color behavior

The appearance of notification colors varies depending on your Android SDK version.

Versions| Color behavior  
---|---  
v7.13.0 or earlier| The collapsed notification uses a white background in the following scenarios:   
  
• You customize only the text color or only the background color (but not both).  
• You enable **Show image preview when notification is collapsed** (available for **[Standard](doc:creatives-android-push-standard)** , **[Carousel](doc:creatives-android-push-carousel)** , and **[Slider](doc:creatives-android-push-slider)** creative types) without customizing colors.  
v7.14.0 or later| • When you customize only the background color, the notification text uses your [app's default text color](doc:customizing-push-notification-images#notification-preview-color-defaults).   
• When you customize only the text color, the notification background is transparent.  
  
* * *

## 

Expandable notification behavior

Push notifications are designed to expand and display the title, message, and banner image together. However, what appears when a notification is expanded varies depending on your Android SDK version.

Versions| Notification behavior  
---|---  
v7.26.0 or earlier| Notifications may not be expandable, and expanded notifications may only display either the banner image or title and message.  
v8.0.0 or later| Notifications are fully expandable, showing the title, message, and banner image simultaneously when expanded.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/ddb67fa8cda39ffbb88ef67af7d1a9064713c936203fe141f6f6d03195f98e9f-expanded-limited-notification.png)
