# Banner

You can create an Android push notification with a single static image, or upload multiple images to build a dynamic, animated banner that cycles through each visual.

![](https://files.readme.io/8b5a35bbbc46d2373cf1989231091ace266e6170a9f415b874c3442f15ddc0aa-banner-gif.gif)

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

To create a banner notification for Android, configure the **Template** and optionally, the **Display settings**.

### 

Template

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title.| Required: Android SDK 6.0.0 or later  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If not set, users go to your default website.  
  
Options:  
• **Single URL across channels**  
• **Custom URL per channel**|  -  
**Banner image**|  Yes| Add up to 10 images for the notification. If multiple images are added, the notification becomes animated, cycling through the images.| • Recommended image size: 600 x 150 pixels   
• Recommended aspect ratio: 4:1  
**Key-value pairs**|  No| Map custom identifiable keys to their values. To learn more, see [Receive key-value pairs](doc:setting-up-notifications#section-receiving-key-value-pairs-in-an-activity).| -  
  
#### 

Banner animation cycle

  1. The total animation time is capped at 15,000 milliseconds (15 seconds).
  2. The cycle duration is calculated as `Time interval × Number of banner images`.
     * If the total cycle time is ≤ 15,000 milliseconds (15 seconds), the banner will animate and complete as many cycles as possible within the 15-second limit. For example:
       * If a cycle takes 6,000 milliseconds (6 seconds), the animation will complete two cycles.
       * If a cycle takes 9,000 milliseconds (9 seconds), the animation will complete one cycle.
     * If the total cycle time exceeds 15,000 milliseconds (15 seconds), the banner will not animate and will only display the first image.
  3. When the animation finishes, the banner stops on the last image of the cycle.

![](https://files.readme.io/c59362501705f5b6256fea8ce28b8dda9bb87fadc426b0738519b75303579e07-app_banner_cycle_variations.png)

### 

(Optional) Display settings

Setting| Description  
---|---  
**Enable heads-up notifications**|  Select this option to show your notifications as floating pop-ups on unlocked devices with Android 5.0 (Lollipop) or later. To learn more, see [Heads-up notifications](doc:entering-app-info-on-aiqua-dashboard#enabling-heads-up-notifications-for-specific-campaigns).  
  
### 

Notification Center settings

Configure how your banner push notification appears in the device's Notification Center:

  * **Pile up notification** : Keeps unclicked notifications in the Notification Center. Note that this option is unavailable when multiple banner images are added. You can optionally use configure the [**Customize notification sounds**](doc:custom-push-notification-sound-for-android).
  * **Replace notification** : Replaces this notification with incoming notifications in the Notification Center.

# Slider

A slider can display multiple big images in a single notification. Just like the carousel, the slider appears in two notification states: collapsed and expanded.

![](https://files.readme.io/34b934acd8861b482e1693b26406a83e6b9e15f15f99c0ef0e553f7dfd851be6-android-slider.png)

Android slider sample: Collapsed and expanded

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

To create a slider notification for Android, configure the **Template** and optionally, the **Display settings**.

### 

Template

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title.| Required: Android SDK 6.0.0 or later  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji.| -  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If not set, users go to your default website.  
  
Options:  
• **Single URL across channels**  
• **Custom URL per channel**|  -  
**Slider images**|  Yes| Upload 2 to 10 images. Click the expand icon on each image to add a deep link and optional key-value pairs.| • Recommended: 512 x 512 pixels  
• Recommended aspect ratio: 1:1  
**Key-value pairs**|  No| Map custom identifiable keys to their values. To learn more, see [Receive key-value pairs](doc:setting-up-notifications#section-receiving-key-value-pairs-in-an-activity).| -  
**Customize notification sound**|  No| Use a custom notification sound for Android users. To learn more, see [Customize notification sounds](doc:custom-push-notification-sound-for-android).| -  
  
### 

(Optional) Display settings

Setting| Description  
---|---  
**Collapsed notification appearance**|  Customize the **Text color** and **Background color** for collapsed notifications. To learn more, see [Color behavior](doc:creatives-android-push#color-behavior).  
**Remove push from Notification Center after user clicks on one of the images**|  Select this option to clear the notification after a user taps a slider image. If not selected, the notification stays until they swipe to remove.  
**Enable heads-up notifications**|  Select this option to show your notifications as floating pop-ups on unlocked devices with Android 5.0 (Lollipop) or later. To learn more, see [Heads-up notifications](doc:entering-app-info-on-aiqua-dashboard#enabling-heads-up-notifications-for-specific-campaigns).

# Standard

Use standard creative to send a basic push notification with optional images and action buttons. Notifications appear collapsed by default. Users swipe down to expand them.

![897](https://files.readme.io/82cac7ad1e5400649f687c9fdf73d6a19b289c9c80fb12fb8a795b44795e6bc1-Android-standard.png)

Android standard sample: Collapsed and expanded

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

To create a standard notification for Android, configure the **Template** and optionally, the **Display settings**.

### 

Template

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title.| Required: Android SDK 6.0.0 or later  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If not set, users go to your default website.  
  
Options:  
• **Single URL across channels**  
• **Custom URL per channel**|  -  
**Big picture image**|  No| Add a big picture image that appears when users expand the notification.   
  
Tips:  
• Keep file size small for faster delivery  
• Avoid placing text in the 10% margins  
  
When you add an image, you can show a preview in the collapsed notification. Go to **Display settings** and turn on **Show image preview when the notification is collapsed**.| • Recommended image size: 1024 x 512 pixels   
• Recommended aspect ratio: Close to 2:1  
**Large icon**|  No| Upload an icon image to display with the Android push notification.| Recommended icon size: 192 x 192 pixels  
**Buttons**|  No| Add up to three action buttons. Choose from:   
  
• **Standard** : Buttons with custom text and optional deep links. Without a link, the button dismisses the notification.  
• **Poll** : A poll with up to three answer options.  
• **Coupon** : A button that copies a coupon code to the user's clipboard.| -  
**Key-value pairs**|  No| Map custom identifiable keys to their values. To learn more, see [Receive key-value pairs](doc:setting-up-notifications#section-receiving-key-value-pairs-in-an-activity).| -  
  
### 

(Optional) Display settings

Setting| Description  
---|---  
**Collapsed notification appearance**|  Customize the **Text color** and **Background color** for collapsed notifications. To learn more, see [Color behavior](doc:creatives-android-push#color-behavior).  
**Enable heads-up notifications**|  Select this option to show your notifications as floating pop-ups on unlocked devices with Android 5.0 (Lollipop) or later. To learn more, see [Heads-up notifications](doc:entering-app-info-on-aiqua-dashboard#enabling-heads-up-notifications-for-specific-campaigns).  
  
### 

Notification Center settings

Configure how your standard push notification appears in the device's Notification Center:

  * **Pile up notification** : Keeps unclicked notifications in the Notification Center. You can optionally use configure the [**Customize notification sounds**](doc:custom-push-notification-sound-for-android).
  * **Replace notification** : Replaces this notification with incoming notifications in the Notification Center.

# Subscription

A subscription creative lets you collect users' phone numbers or email addresses so they can subscribe to your notifications. Users can submit their contact information directly from the notification without opening the app.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> By default, subscription notifications replace previous notifications in the Notification Center.

![](https://files.readme.io/5927d1292b2cfe57f0d42d477f8b68227e233b5e3917c82f10d927ffe65eb13b-android-subscription-email.png)

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

To create a subscription notification for Android, configure the **Template** and optionally, the **Display settings**.

### 

Template

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title.| Required: Android SDK 6.0.0 or later  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Although this field is required, the destination URL isn't supported for subscription notifications. Users won't be redirected to any destination when they tap the notification.| -  
**Subscription method**|  Yes| The contact method for subscription: **Phone number** or **Email**.| -  
**Button text**|  Yes| The text displayed on the subscription action button.| -  
**Key-value pairs**|  No| Select this option to send custom data to your app. To learn more, see [(Optional) Receiving Key-Value Pairs](doc:setting-up-notifications#section-receiving-key-value-pairs-in-an-activity).| -  
**Customize notification sound**|  No| Use a custom notification sound for Android users. To learn more, see [Customize notification sounds](doc:custom-push-notification-sound-for-android).| -  
  
### 

(Optional) Display settings

# Email Creatives

Learn how to design email creatives.

> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported campaign types
> 
>   * [Regular campaigns](doc:campaigns-regular-create-email)
>   * [Trigger campaigns](doc:campaigns-trigger)
> 


![](https://files.readme.io/ea9f3b3235f7b19bb2ce49d7f5bef0194476097a8a13c99c8d1dfe86e7f9f2d9-email-sample.png)

* * *

## 

Add an email creative

To design your email body, click **\+ Add email creative** and choose one of the following:

  * **Default templates** : Start with a default template provided by Appier. For details, see [Email templates](doc:email-templates).
  * **My template** : Start from a template you created previously.
  * **Create your own** : Build from scratch using the [**Drag & drop editor**](doc:creatives-email-drag-and-drop-editor) or [**HTML editor**](doc:creatives-email-html-editor).

![](https://files.readme.io/0895853d58f909c5db3aeee80edbf81611e72fe44bc3604bbbf90d5ee61e8293-email-creatives.png)

### 

Create your own

Build custom emails from scratch using one of two editors:

[ ![Drag and drop](https://files.readme.io/1a57cd3b454391a81fc8447aa4623c661ffad47772c9c8d589edfe8d53b52465-Drag__drop.png) Drag and drop editor ](/docs/creatives-email-drag-and-drop-editor) [ ![HTML editor](https://files.readme.io/12edc14d28e4f510c0479859bd3d336771c4ac32aba8619220c103753532131c-HTML_editor.png) HTML editor ](/docs/creatives-email-html-editor)

* * *

## 

Creative settings

Configure how your email appears in recipients' inboxes and where replies are directed.

![](https://files.readme.io/eb2e92d699de307efe2fc8c10027a0448753f1ee4d859d2b10eb0947a3c4b4a9-email-creatives-common-settings.png)

Setting| Description  
---|---  
**Sender email address**|  Choose the email address that will appear as the sender.  
**Sender name**|  Enter the display name of the sender.  
**Email subject**|  Enter a catchy subject line. This field supports [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#subject-line-of-the-email).  
**Set custom reply-to address and name**|  Enable this option to set a custom **Reply to email address** and **Reply-to name** for replies and bounces.  
**Enable UTM tracking**|  Enable this option to automatically append UTM parameters to all links in your email for external performance tracking.  
  
> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> When the message size exceeds 102 kb, Gmail clips the email and replaces the exceeded parts with a “View entire message” link. The message size is determined by the byte size of the email’s code (such as text, URLs, and tracking code) rather than the size of images.
> 
> ![](https://files.readme.io/043ab6d-Screen_Shot_2020-03-09_at_2.18.03_PM.png)

### 

Enable UTM tracking

Toggle the **Enable UTM tracking** on to automatically add tracking parameters to your email links for tools like Google Analytics. The parameter fields are pre-filled with your [account’s default values](doc:user-settings#default-utm-parameters), which you can then customize for this specific campaign.

Parameter| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Campaign source**|  Yes| The `utm_source` parameter that identifies the referrer that sent the traffic, such as `appier`.  
**Campaign medium**|  Yes| The `utm_medium` parameter that identifies the marketing medium used, such as `email`.  
**Campaign name**|  Yes| The `utm_campaign` parameter that identifies the specific marketing effort. Click the `{...}` icon to select dynamic variables like **Campaign name** or **Campaign type**.  
**Campaign term**|  No| The `utm_term` parameter that identifies paid keywords associated with the campaign.  
**Campaign content**|  No| The `utm_content` that differentiates links or creatives within an email.  
  
> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Remove these UTM parameters from your email links before publishing the campaign: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, or `utm_content`.
> 
> ![](https://files.readme.io/1c004b5129308cd5aea083a1a8f666d1760a203fc71d38e0f38308ef43cafa72-clean-URL.png)

The **URL preview** at the bottom of the section displays how your final link will appear with all encoded parameters and dynamic variables.

# Drag and Drop Editor

Use the drag-and-drop editor to create custom email creatives. To access the editor, [create an email campaign](doc:campaigns-regular-create-email), go to the **Creative** section, select **\+ Add email creative** , then select **Create your own** > **Drag & drop editor.**

![](https://files.readme.io/56dfbed4929859d2af4fcb71866d3cbb7cfb65c029c20cec4d0c2d6a7bc44624-email-drag-and-drop.png)

* * *

## 

Create creatives with the drag and drop editor

The editor includes three tabs: **Content** , **Rows** , **Settings**.

![](https://files.readme.io/93b1a22-regular_campaign_design_email_content_marked.png)

### 

Configure settings

Start by clicking the **Settings** tab to adjust overall settings, including:

  * Content area width

  * Content area alignment

  * Background color

  * Content area background color

  * Default font

  * Link color

  * (Optional) Set the preheader text. The preheader appears next to the subject line in your recipients' inboxes and provides a brief preview of your email. You can add dynamic content and emojis to make your preheader more engaging.

![](https://files.readme.io/216965a0b657ffd65dabecf173b81057d6eca853057d8ecb580db25322f63c2e-email_campaign__new_settings.png)



### 

Add rows

Click the **Rows** tab to add different types of rows inside your email's body. Drag a row, and then drop it anywhere you see **Drag it here**.

To make adjustments, click the white space on the two sides of the row to see its **Row properties** on the right.

![](https://files.readme.io/8063cca-regular_campaign_design_email_row_and_column_properties_marked.png)

### 

Add content

  1. Click the **Content** tab to add content blocks inside your email's body.
  2. Drag an available feature block from the right, and drop it anywhere you see **Drag it here**.

![](https://files.readme.io/4adf0bb-regular_campaign_design_email_content_drag_and_drop.gif)

  3. Click on the content block to access **Content properties** on the right.

![](https://files.readme.io/989e661-Screen_Shot_2020-06-23_at_7.13.11_PM.png)

  4. If you click on a text box or button you can customize the text options.

![](https://files.readme.io/dbb6d40-Screen_Shot_2020-06-23_at_7.15.38_PM.png)

The following types of Content are available:

  * **Text** : This lets you add a static or [dynamic text](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#drag--drop-editor-text) in the email editor.
  * **Image** : This lets you add a static or [dynamic image](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#drag--drop-editor-image) in the email editor.
    1. Click **Browse** to select the type of image you want to add.
    2. You can select **Upload** to upload an image from your computer, or **Search free photos** to do an image search. Corresponding images are retrieved from available [Creative commons](https://creativecommons.org/about/) galleries.
    3. Select the image you want to use and then click **Insert**. The image appears in the Image box you dropped in the editor.

![](https://files.readme.io/c93609e-regular_campaign_design_email_content_image_static_file_manager_select.gif)

> 🚧
> 
> ### 
> 
> Important
> 
> It is suggested to not use Imgur to host your images, because Gmail tends to block emails that contain Imgur images.

  * **Button** : This lets you add an action button in your email.
  * **Divider** : Add this to separate the elements in your email with a horizontal line.
  * **Social** : This lets you add social media icons to your email message and link them to a corresponding social media account.
  * **HTML** : This lets you add your own HTML code to an email message. The HTML block you added turns into an HTML preview when you start adding your HTML code under **Content properties**.

![](https://files.readme.io/95b27f3-regular_campaign_design_email_content_html_other_options_add_code.gif)

  * **Video** : This lets you add a video in your email using a URL.
  * **Icon** : This lets you add an icon in your email. For example, a location icon in front of your business address.



### 

Add unsubscription links

> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> One-click unsubscribe
> 
> If you're using [AIQUA's default unsubscribe URL](doc:user-settings#use-appiers-default-unsubscribe-url) and you insert an unsubscription link in the editor, a one-click unsubscribe button (via list-unsubscribe header) is automatically included with the email.

There are a couple of ways to add unsubscribe links to your email.

  * Click on the text box, click **More** , and select **Insert unsubscription link**.

![](https://files.readme.io/a15fe9c-Screen_Shot_2020-07-21_at_10.06.23_AM.png)

  * Click on a button, go to **Content properties** on the right, and click **Insert unsubscription link** under the Url field.

![](https://files.readme.io/2464706-Screen_Shot_2020-07-21_at_10.14.59_AM.png)

  * In the HTML block, insert `{{ aiqua_unsub_url }}` in the HTML `<a>` tag.

![](https://files.readme.io/1fdbc50-Screen_Shot_2020-07-21_at_11.09.02_AM.png)

* * *

## 

Use dynamic content in the email editor

In email campaigns, you can use dynamic content that changes based on each user's behaviors and attributes. For more details, see [Dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#dynamic-content-in-email-campaigns).

![](https://files.readme.io/5e6cf57-Screen_Shot_2020-07-07_at_6.46.45_PM.png)

# HTML Editor

AIQUA's **Email HTML Editor** allows you to create and preview email templates made with custom HTML. You can choose to save your custom HTML as a [template](doc:email-templates) which can be reused in future campaigns.

![1213](https://files.readme.io/56325f7-Screen_Shot_2022-02-08_at_3.17.45_PM.png)

* * *

## 

Usage notes

To avoid unexpected differences between the in-editor preview, the thumbnail preview in the AIQUA Dashboard, and your final campaign email, make sure to:

  * Declare a character encoding scheme.
  * Check that the HTML used in your template is supported by the email client(s) you are targeting.



* * *

## 

Declare a character encoding scheme

If your HTML template doesn't include a character encoding declaration, non-English text may not display properly in your campaign email. To prevent this issue, include an encoding declaration in your HTML's `<head>` tag specifying an encoding scheme.

For example, an encoding declaration specifying the `utf-8` scheme looks like this:

HTML
    
    
    <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8">
    </head>

and a full HTML file using the `utf-8` encoding looks like this:

HTML
    
    
    <html>
      <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8"> <!-- Encoding declaration -->
        <title>AIQUA Email HTML Editor</title>
      </head>
      <body>
        <p>The text on this page is encoded in UTF-8.</p>
      </body>
    </html>

* * *

## 

Check for supported HTML tags and CSS properties

Not all email clients support all available HTML tags and CSS properties, so it's important to check if your custom HTML contains tags or properties unsupported by a particular email client.

Tools like [[www.caniemail.com](http://www.caniemail.com)](https://www.caniemail.com) allow you to search for specific HTML tags, CSS properties, or email clients to determine if your custom HTML will be fully supported, as seen below.

![2298](https://files.readme.io/451cb94-can-i-email.png)

The `background-color` property is supported by all Apple Mail, Gmail, and Outlook email clients.

Searching by tag or property name returns columns of email providers (such as **Gmail** and **Outlook**) and sub-columns of email clients from that provider (such as **iOS** and **Android**). Email clients that support the tag or property you specified will contain a green box with a checkmark.

# In-App Creatives

Learn how to design in-app creatives.

## 

Pop-up creatives

Select a template to design your in-app pop-up notification creatives:

[ ![Basic template](https://files.readme.io/2ed97e385730a4b62621443cde1e58a72525ab0f02bfc73656b657cf64ae9c5a-In-app_Campaign.png) Basic template Select one of four basic templates to design your pop-up notification. ](/docs/creatives-in-app-basic-templates) [ ![Creative Studio](https://files.readme.io/41adb8973ff0bf7945324ef1ced106d187a24e48c117bd582dab9af3cbfffa05-Creative_templates.png) Creative Studio Use drag-and-drop editor to design your pop-up notification. ](/docs/creative-studio) [ ![HTML editor](https://files.readme.io/41bc293e71ecd0cce22bd2feb9349cfeadaa176db2c5aacff2800cea3bb37e35-HTML_editor.png) HTML editor Create your own pop-up notification with HTML. ](/docs/creatives-in-app-html-editor)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> After a campaign becomes active, you cannot switch to a different creative template (for example, if an active in-app campaign uses **Basic template** , you cannot change it to **Creative Studio**).

* * *

## 

Inbox creatives

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Beta feature
> 
> In-app inbox campaigns are a beta feature and require additional SDK integration:
> 
>   * [Inbox Notifications for Android](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/in-app-inbox-notifications-for-android)
>   * [Inbox Notifications for iOS](https://docs.aiqua.appier.com/docs/in-app-inbox-notifications-for-ios)
> 


An inbox campaign creatives requires the following configuration:

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Supports plain text, [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), and emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.  
**Message**|  No| Your main notification message. Supports plain text, [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), and emoji.  
**Deep link**|  No| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If you do not set a deep link, users go to your default website.  
**Image**|  No| Add an image to your notification.

# Basic Templates

AIQUA offers the following types of basic creatives for in-app pop-up notifications:

![](https://files.readme.io/68863cf9aafb08c0413d5c3c445d82703c5252d6b62c277d1b8168acfbbe376f-in-app-basic-template.png)

[ ![Fixed banner](https://files.readme.io/4afe354c548b15c7cfd8c0917cc321803747c5dc883391f667d3ff1be9f793a6-In-app-floating-icon.png) Floating text ](/docs/creatives-in-app-basic-templates-floating-text) [ ![Small](https://files.readme.io/c013decade8a1784cc21f5d999e074fa26f25ce2cd4968b5e884f1ddc7d9c089-In-app-small.png) Small ](/docs/creatives-in-app-basic-templates-small) [ ![Medium](https://files.readme.io/000d331e91e01ee97aea7a516af4e73e04d685ba135f22eae86d119e4f04dd76-In-app-medium.png) Medium ](/docs/creatives-in-app-basic-templates-medium) [ ![Full screen](https://files.readme.io/000d331e91e01ee97aea7a516af4e73e04d685ba135f22eae86d119e4f04dd76-In-app-medium.png) Full screen ](/docs/creatives-in-app-basic-templates-full-screen)

* * *

## 

Pop-up design

Configure how your in-app pop-up notification appears and behaves based on user interaction:

  * **Persistence**
  * **Initial state**
  * **Close button**



### 

Persistence

Select when the notification disappears based on user interaction.

  * **Persist** : The notification collapses to a floating icon and remains accessible until the user dismisses it or exits the app. Use this option when users might need to access the notification multiple times.
  * **Persist until the notification is clicked** : The notification collapses into a floating icon when closed, but disappears completely after the user clicks the notification content or deep link. Use this option when users need to interact once but should control the timing.
  * **Don 't persist**: The notification disappears immediately after any user interaction. Use this option for one-time announcements or time-sensitive updates.



Notification behavior varies by template type and click area. To learn how each persistence option works with your selected template, see:

  * [Floating text](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates-floating-text#notification-persistence)
  * [Small](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates-small#notification-persistence)
  * [Medium](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates-medium#notification-persistence)
  * [Full screen](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates-full-screen#notification-persistence)



### 

Initial state

Select whether the notification appears expanded or collapsed when users first see it.

  * **Expanded** : The notification displays with full content visible.
  * **Collapsed** : The notification appears as a floating icon. Users taps the icon to expand the notification.

![862](https://files.readme.io/e7c7259-Screen_Shot_2020-11-12_at_6.37.45_PM.png)

Left: Expanded. Right: Collapsed.

* * *

## 

(Optional) Enable background overlay

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported versions
> 
>   * iOS SDK 7.21.0 or later
>   * Android SDK 7.13.0 or later
> 

> 
> Earlier versions enable the background overlay regardless of your dashboard settings.

Enable the background overlay to prevent users from interacting with the app while the notification displays. Users can close or collapse the notification by selecting the grayed-out background area.

![](https://files.readme.io/1842859ae3b65be1994835ba7579783d51604266b645a4a8307b3204ac3ce8ea-background-overlay.png)

* * *

## 

Floating icon

Users can drag the floating icon anywhere on the screen, or drag it off-screen to dismiss it. To configure the floating icon, upload an icon image, set up the margin from top, and choose an initial position.

![886](https://files.readme.io/a9abc4c-ios_in_app_floating_dismissed_by_doing_drag-and-drop.png)

### 

Icon image

Upload an icon image for the floating notification. Ensure your image file meets the following specifications:

  * Size: 192 x 192 pixels
  * Aspect ratio: Close to 2:1
  * Format:
    * JPG, PNG (all SDK versions)
    * GIF (Supported in Android SDK 7.25.0 or later and iOS SDK 7.33.0 or later)
    * APNG (Supported in iOS SDK 7.33.0 or later)
    * For GIF and APNG files, use smaller file sizes to improve display speed and performance. On devices running iOS 13 or earlier, only the first frame displays.



### 

Margin from top

Set the vertical distance from the top of the screen to the floating icon. For optimal placement, enter a value between 100 and 400 to ensure the icon remains reachable without blocking the app's navigation or status bar.

The unit label for the **Margin from top** automatically updates based on your selected platform:

  * iOS: pt
  * Android: dp



### 

Initial position

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported versions
> 
>   * Android SDK 7.8.0 or later
>   * iOS SDK 7.16.0 or later
> 


Select which side of the device screen the floating icon initially appears on:

  * **Attach to left edge** : The floating icon appears on the left side of the screen.
  * **Attach to right edge** : The floating icon appears on the right side of the screen.



Users can drag the icon to either side after it appears.

* * *

## 

(Optional) Close button

Add a close button (×) to the floating icon, the pop-up notification, or both, so users can dismiss it explicitly.

![](https://files.readme.io/fcc19f2-Screen_Shot_2022-07-11_at_2.12.04_PM.png)

### 

Floating icon

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported versions
> 
>   * Android SDK 6.4.0 or later
>   * iOS SDK 7.3.0 or later
> 


Enable **Show a close button on the pop-up notification** so when users click the close button, the notification behavior depends on your persistence setting.

### 

Pop-up notification

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported versions
> 
>   * Template: **Floating text**
>     * Android SDK 6.4.0 or later
>     * iOS SDK 7.3.0 or later
>   * Template: **Small** , **Medium** , **Full screen**
>     * Android SDK 6.9.0 or later
>     * iOS SDK 7.7.0 or later
> 


Enable **Show a close button on the floating icon** to allow users to close and dismiss the floating icon from the screen. When this option isn't selected, users can dismiss the icon by dragging it off-screen.

# Floating Text

Use the **Floating text** template to display a quick text pop-up notification in your app.

![](https://files.readme.io/423118ad053ac2e21c5362bcae27a011b601bd501a32f1526c61d5b065c31e57-Floating-text.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Supports plain text, [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), and emoji.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Deep link**|  No| Where users go when users tap the notification.| -  
[**Pop-up design**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#pop-up-design)|  Yes| Settings for how the notification looks and notification persistence behavior.| -  
[**Floating icon**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#floating-icon)|  Yes| Settings for how the **Floating icon** looks and behaves.   
  
If [**Persistence**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#persistence) is set to **Don’t persist** , you must also set up the **Click behavior** for the floating icon.| -  
  
* * *

## 

Notification persistence

Click area| Setting: **Persist**|  Setting: **Persist until notification is clicked**|  Setting: **Don 't persist**  
---|---|---|---  
Message only| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
Message with deep link| Opens deep link and collapse into a floating icon.| Opens deep link and disappears when the user clicks on a message with deep link.| Opens deep link and disappears when clicked.  
Close button| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
Floating icon (Initial state: Expanded)| Collapses into a floating icon when the icon is clicked.| Collapses into a floating icon when the icon is clicked.| Behavior depends on Click behavior:  
• **Hide the notification** : Disappears  
• **Open the deep link** : Opens link and disappears  
Floating icon (Initial state: Collapsed)| Expands the notification when the icon is clicked.| Expands the notification when the icon is clicked.| Expands the notification when the icon is clicked.  
  
* * *

## 

Click behavior

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported versions
> 
>   * Android SDK 7.10.0 or later
>   * iOS SDK 7.18.0 or later
> 

> 
> Earlier versions use **Hide the notification** behavior regardless of your dashboard settings.

This setting is available only when [Persistence](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#persistence) is set to **Don 't persist**, to configure what happens when users tap the floating icon.

![](https://files.readme.io/eedf9d9d192fdbdb2eb5002f75207e7ebce1bfa21a93f7e3a37aaa7c6247d5cd-floating-image-click-behavior.png)

### 

Hide the notification

Use this option when your notification doesn't link anywhere. The floating icon acts like a toggle: users can tap once to read the message, then tap again to close it.

  * If the initial state is **Collapsed** : The notification expands on the user's first tap, and both the notification and floating icon disappear on their next tap.
  * If the initial state is **Expanded** : Both the notification and floating icon closes right away from app after user's first tap.



### 

Open the deep link

Use this option when you want the floating icon to work as a shortcut to specific content in your app. Users can read the message, then tap the icon to jump to that content.

  * If the initial state is **Collapsed** :
    1. The notification expands on the user's first tap.
    2. Users go to the deep link location on their next tap.
    3. Both the notification and floating icon disappear right away. If you haven't configured a deep link, users stay on the same screen and both disappear.
  * If the initial state is **Expanded** : Users go to the deep link location right away, and both the notification and floating icon disappears.

# Full Screen

Use the **Full screen** template to display a large image that covers the entire screen for grabbing maximum attention.

![](https://files.readme.io/7c1e94aaf4adc5698ab60c6afcfa443e2a7e50467a07cdf9afdeecec760b8f3a-Full-screen.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Image**|  Yes| A full-screen image that adjusts to match your user's screen size.| • Recommended image size: 720 x 1280 pixels   
• Recommended aspect ratio: 9:16  
• Supported file format: JPG, PNG, GIF*, APNG*   
  
* Note: Supported formats vary by SDK version. For details about format specifications, see Image and format support.  
**Action button**|  No| Turn this on to add up to two action buttons with deep link destination.   
  
You'll need to configure:   
• **Background color**  
• **Button alignment** (Choose **Horizontal** or **Vertical**)  
• **Button text**  
• **Button background color** and **Deep link**|  -  
[**Enable background overlay**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#optional-enable-background-overlay)|  No| Turn this on to prevent users from closing or collapsing the background page while the campaign is displayed.| -  
[**Pop-up design**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#pop-up-design)|  Yes| Settings for how the notification looks and notification persistence behavior.| -  
[**Floating icon**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#floating-icon)|  Yes| Settings for how the **Floating icon** looks and behaves.| -  
  
### 

Image and format support

  * Animated files (GIF/APNG): Use smaller file sizes to ensure fast loading performance.
    * GIF: Supported on Android SDK 7.24.4 or later and iOS SDK 7.32.4 or later.
    * APNG: Supported on iOS SDK 7.33.0 or later.
  * Image ratio: While 9:16 is recommended, full screen images scale differently on various devices. For details about image sizing, see Best practices.



* * *

## 

Notification persistence

Click area| Setting: Persist| Setting: Persist until notification is clicked| Setting: Don't persist  
---|---|---|---  
Image| Not interactive.| Not interactive.| Not interactive.  
Action button without a deep link| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when the user clicks the action button.  
Action button with a deep link| Opens deep link and collapses into a floating icon.| Opens deep link and disappears when clicked.| Opens deep link and disappears when clicked.  
Close button| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when the user clicks on close button.  
Overlay background| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
Floating icon| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.  
  
* * *

## 

Best practices

### 

Show a close button for full screen notification

We recommend including a [close button](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#optional-close-button) or an action button in your **Full screen** creative. On some devices, a **Full screen** notification can cover the entire screen completely. When this happens, the pop-up notification can only be dismissed by tapping an action button, a close button, or by moving the app into the background.

### 

Choose the right image ratio

Full screen templates scale to match the device screen size. A 9:16 aspect ratio works well for most devices, but you may need to adjust depending on your target devices:

  * A 9:16 image fits well on 9:19.5 screens, but may be cropped at the top and bottom on shorter aspect ratios such as 9:18 or 9:16.
  * A 2:3 image fits well on 9:16 screens, but may be cropped on the left and right on taller aspect ratios such as 9:18, 9:19, or 9:19.5.



### 

Consider landscape mode

Full screen images are optimized for portrait orientation. In landscape mode, the image may be cropped at the top and bottom due to its height. To avoid cropping, use a [Medium](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates-medium) template instead of a full screen one.

# Medium

Use the **Medium** template to display an eye-catching pop-up notification that includes a header image, text, and buttons, to highlight promotions or special offers.

![](https://files.readme.io/3aa28975fd79dd30d9123e27c8bbadd914a7e76c78af74dbdfea8ba0331a41ee-Medium.png)

* * *

## 

Creative content

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Supports plain text, [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), and emoji.| Must be 125 characters or less  
**Image**|  Yes| A header image that appears at the top of your notification.| • Recommended image size: 512 x 512 pixels   
• Recommended aspect ratio: 1:1   
• Recommended file format: JPG, PNG, GIF*, and APNG*   
  
* Note: Supported format vary by SDK versions. For details about format specifications, see Image and format support.  
**Button**|  No| Add up to two action buttons with deep link destinations.   
  
You can change the **Button background color** , however, the button text color isn't adjustable.| -  
[**Enable background overlay**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#optional-enable-background-overlay)|  No| Turn on to prevent users from closing or collapsing the background page while the notification is displayed.| -  
[**Pop-up design**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#pop-up-design)|  Yes| Settings for how the notification looks and notification persistence behavior.| -  
[**Floating icon**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#floating-icon)|  Yes| Settings for how the **Floating icon** looks and behaves.| -  
  
### 

Image and format support

  * Image ratio: Use a 1:1 aspect ratio for the best presentation on all devices. Older iOS versions (SDK 7.26.0 or earlier) support a 2:1 ratio. However, newer versions (SDK 7.27.0 or later) automatically crop 2:1 images to a square.
  * Animated files (GIF/APNG): Use smaller file sizes to ensure fast loading performance.
    * GIF: Supported on Android SDK 7.24.4 or later and iOS SDK 7.32.4 or later.
    * APNG: Supported on iOS SDK 7.33.0 or later.



* * *

## 

Notification persistence

Click area| Setting: Persist| Setting: Persist until notification is clicked| Setting: Don't persist  
---|---|---|---  
Image or message| No change.| No change.| No change.  
Action button without a deep link| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when the user clicks the action button.  
Action button with a deep link| Opens deep link and collapses into a floating icon.| Opens deep link and disappears when clicked.| Opens deep link and disappears when clicked.  
Close button| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when the user clicks on close button.  
Overlay background| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
Floating icon| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.

# Small

Use the **Small** template to display a simple, text-only alert with call-to-action buttons pop-up notification.

![](https://files.readme.io/8a637984eee75f554642b010af6a1ccb4c4bff2e35de94148029f2b762232ead-Small.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Supports plain text, [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Supports plain text, [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), and emoji.| Must be 125 characters or less  
**Button**|  Yes| Add up to two action buttons with deep link destinations.   
  
You can change the **Button background color** , however, the button text color isn't adjustable.| -  
[**Enable background overlay**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#optional-enable-background-overlay)|  No| Toggle on to prevent users from closing or collapsing the background page while the notification is displayed.| -  
[**Pop-up design**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#pop-up-design)|  Yes| Settings for how the notification looks and notification persistence behavior. You can change the **Title background color**.| -  
[**Floating icon**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#floating-icon)|  Yes| Settings for how the **Floating icon** looks and behaves.| -  
  
* * *

## 

Notification persistence

Click area| Setting: Persistence| Setting: Persist until notification is clicked| Setting: Don't persist  
---|---|---|---  
Message| No change.| No change.| No change.  
Action button without a deep link| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when the user clicks the action button.  
Action button with a deep link| Opens deep link and collapses into a floating icon.| Opens deep link and disappears when clicked.| Opens deep link and disappears when clicked.  
Close button| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when the user clicks on close button.  
Overlay background| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
Floating icon| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.

# HTML Editor

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Supported versions
> 
>   * Android SDK versions 5.7.0 or later
>   * iOS SDK versions 4.6.0 or later
> 


Use the HTML editor in in-app pop-up notification to create app-based promotions with custom branding and deep links. These campaigns run within your mobile app through the web view feature, letting you deliver dynamic and personalized promotions without disrupting the in-app experience.

![](https://files.readme.io/2e2c92ab5adbf2389784dbf0915e0ebbba8f2905980fb8493b71ef35fde27418-in-app-html-editor.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
[**Enable background overlay**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#optional-enable-background-overlay)|  No| Toggle on to prevent users from closing or collapsing the background page while the notification is displayed.  
[**Pop-up design**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#pop-up-design)|  Yes| Settings for how the notification looks and notification persistence behavior.  
[**Floating icon**](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#floating-icon)|  Yes| Settings for how the **Floating icon** looks and behaves.  
**HTML body**|  Yes| Modify the HTML template in the editor to customize your pop-up notification.  
  
* * *

## 

Notification persistence

Notification behavior varies on each persistence setting when users interact with different HTML attribute or click different areas:

Click area| **Persist**| **Persist until the notification is clicked**| **Don 't persist**  
---|---|---|---  
HTML attribute `aiq-deeplink`| Opens deep link and collapses into a floating icon.| Opens deep link and disappears.| Opens deep link and disappears.  
HTML attribute `aiq-close`| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
HTML attribute `aiq-close-kill`| Creative and floating icon disappear. The campaign won't be displayed again unless the app is reinstalled.| Creative and floating icon disappear. The campaign won't be displayed again unless the app is reinstalled.| Creative and floating icon disappear. The campaign won't be displayed again unless the app is reinstalled.  
Close button (system)| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
Overlay background| Collapses into a floating icon.| Collapses into a floating icon.| Disappears when clicked.  
Floating icon| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.| Expands creative when clicked.  
  
* * *

## 

HTML template

This HTML editor comes with a ready-to-use HTML template, which can be customized with the following AIQUA attributes.

HTML Template
    
    
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
      <meta charset="UTF-8">
      <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
      <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="ie=edge">
    </head>
    <body>
      <div id="aiq-inapp">
        <div class="title">This is your Primary Heading.</div>
        <div class="message">Add some more descriptive content here to describe your product or service in a more detailed way. This could also be an explanation of the details of your offer if you are running a promotion.</div>
        <button class="button" aiq-deeplink="<!-- PLEASE REPLACE YOUR LINK -->" aiq-close>Button</button>
      </div>
    
      <style>
        * {
          box-sizing: border-box;
        }
    
        html, body {
          margin: 0;
        }
    
        #aiq-inapp {
          background-color: #fff;
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 600px;
          padding: 20px;
        }
    
        #aiq-inapp .title {
          width: 260px;
          height: 82px;
          font-size: 30px;
          font-weight: 600;
          color: #000;
          white-space: normal;
          margin: 0 0 10px;
        }
    
        #aiq-inapp .message {
          width: 260px;
          height: 114px;
          font-size: 14px;
          color: #000;
          white-space: normal;
          margin: 0 0 85px;
        }
    
        #aiq-inapp .button {
          appearance: none;
          -webkit-appearance: none;
          display: block;
          width: 100%;
          font-size: 14px;
          font-weight: 600;
          text-align: center;
          color: #fff;
          line-height: 40px;
          border-radius: 5px;
          border: none;
          background-color: #0090ff;
          cursor: pointer;
        }
      </style>
    </body>
    </html>

* * *

## 

AIQUA attributes

The following attributes let you customize the behavior of the close button, add deep links, and log some user events when building your own creative using the in-app pop-up notification's HTML editor.

### 

Buttons

Button| Description| Sample  
---|---|---  
`aiq-close`| This attribute dismisses the HTML popup creative and turns it into a [floating icon](doc:creatives-in-app-basic-templates#floating-icon).| aiq-close sample
    
    
    <button aiq-close>Dismiss</button>  
  
`aiq-close-kill`| This attribute dismisses both the HTML pop-up creative and its floating icon. This campaign will never be displayed again unless the app is reinstalled by the user. Modifying the campaign doesn't take effect after the in-app is shown.| aiq-close-kill sample
    
    
    <button aiq-close-kill>Dismiss</button>  
  
> 🚧
> 
> ### 
> 
> Known issue
> 
> In Android SDK versions 7.17.0 to 7.20.0, `aiq-close-kill` would close the in-app campaign, but wouldn't fully kill it. As a result, relaunching the app would allow the campaign to display again.
> 
> To avoid this issue, please use Android SDK 7.21.0 or later.

### 

Logging events

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note:
> 
>   * The `href` tag is not supported. Refer to `aiq-deeplink` instead.
>   * In the HTML code, the `<a>` `</a>` tag without an `href` doesn’t appear with an underline.
> 


Use `aiq-event-name` attribute to log a user event and its corresponding label or event name.

aiq-event-name sample
    
    
    <a aiq-event-name='checkout_completed'>Log a checkout_completed event</a>

### 

Deep link or universal link embedding

> 🚧
> 
> ### 
> 
> Important:
> 
>   * Use `aiq-deeplink` to embed links.
>   * `onclick` function is disabled as well as all click events are prevented by default unless AIQUA tags are used.
> 


#### 

**`aiq-deeplink`**

Link type| Description| Format  
---|---|---  
Universal link| To embed a universal link, deep link, specific web, or app pages, for example: `https://mybusiness/product.com`| Universal Link Sample
    
    
    <button aiq-deeplink='https://mybusiness/product.com'>link</button>  
  
Deep link| For other actions, this is the accepted deep link format: `scheme://resource`. A sample of this would be: `aiquademo://profile?user=JohnSu`| Deep Link Sample
    
    
    <button aiq-deeplink='aiquademo://profile?user=JohnSu'>link</button>  
  
Image button| To open a link from an image button.| Image Button Sample
    
    
    <button><img class="image" aiq-deeplink='https://mybusiness.com' src="https://mybusiness.com/sample.png"></button>

# In-Web Creatives

Learn how to design in-web creatives.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Before you begin
> 
> [Integrate your website with the Appier Web SDK](doc:integrating-with-the-aiqua-web-sdk) to create in-web campaigns.

## 

Browser compatibility

### 

Basic templates and HTML editor

Device| Supported browsers  
---|---  
Desktop| Chrome, Edge, Firefox  
Mobile| Chrome, Safari, Firefox  
  
### 

Creative Studio

Supported browsers| Not supported  
---|---  
• Chrome   
• Firefox| • Internet Explorer   
• Safari  
• Any browsers in incognito mode  
  
* * *

## 

Choose your creative template

[ ![Basic templates](https://files.readme.io/859fc5991e739d7c1741680b820bf38e9dcad1b723c47f09f11ac621513f4765-In-web_Campaign.png) Basic templates ](/docs/creatives-in-web-basic-templates) [ ![HTML Editor](https://files.readme.io/41bc293e71ecd0cce22bd2feb9349cfeadaa176db2c5aacff2800cea3bb37e35-HTML_editor.png) HTML Editor ](/docs/creatives-in-web-html-editor) [ ![Creative Studio](https://files.readme.io/41adb8973ff0bf7945324ef1ced106d187a24e48c117bd582dab9af3cbfffa05-Creative_templates.png) Creative Studio ](/docs/creative-studio)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> In-web campaigns don't support dynamic content.

* * *

## 

Preview on website

Generate a preview link to see how your creative appears on your website:

  1. Click **Generate link** , enter the URL of your website, and click **Generate link**.
  2. Then:
     * Click **Open link** to view the preview in a new browser tab.
     * Click **Copy link** to copy the preview URL to your clipboard if you want to share the preview link.

![](https://files.readme.io/72529715d3b5ba5fb52b0d44b6956f09dec0dd27f57bcc3e49e55bfd5dbbec2d-in-web-generate-link.png)

### 

Preview limitations

  * Link expiration: Preview links expire seven days after you generate them.
  * Availability: Previews aren't available for [Subscription Boost](doc:creatives-in-web-basic-templates-subscription-boost).
  * URL redirects: The preview won't work if your website redirects to a different URL and removes the `?aiq_preview=` parameter.
  * Analytics tracking: Preview visits won't affect your campaign data or analytics. The system doesn't record user events (such as `page_viewed` or `qg_inweb_clicked`), user attributes, or lead form submissions from preview links.

# Basic Templates

Learn about in-web creative basic templates.

AIQUA provides five basic templates for in-web notifications that help you share information, collect user data, and encourage web push subscriptions:

  * [Fixed banner](doc:creatives-in-web-basic-templates-fixed-banner)
  * [Multiple actions](doc:creatives-in-web-basic-templates-multiple-actions)
  * [Multiple images](doc:creatives-in-web-basic-templates-multiple-images)
  * [Lead generation](doc:creatives-in-web-basic-templates-lead-generation)
  * [Subscription boost](doc:creatives-in-web-basic-templates-subscription-boost)
